articles._body: The Indiana Pacers are less than two months away from kicking off their 2026-27 season, looking to bounce back after an injury-riddled 2025-26 campaign. The Pacers paid a steep price last year to bring in former Los Angeles Clippers center Ivica Zubac , sending out a pick that ultimately ended up being number five overall to the Clippers in the process. Zubac is currently competing in the FIBA World Cup qualifiers in Europe, and on Sunday, he put up a huge stat line for his native Croatia. “Ivica Zubac posted 24 points, 11 rebounds and two blocks to help Croatia edge the Netherlands 101-99. The center shot 8-of-10 from the field,” reported Eurohoops. Zubac was a strong starting center for the Clippers for several years, and after Myles Turner melted down in the NBA Finals and then bolted in free agency, it was clear that the Pacers were in need of an upgrade in that department. Still, many fans found the price hard to justify after the NBA lottery revealed that the Clippers would be holding onto the Pacers’ coveted first-round pick, essentially giving Indiana nothing to show for all of the hardship they endured last season, which Tyrese Haliburton missed due to injury. Haliburton will be back in the mix this year as he takes the court for the first time since tearing his Achilles in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals against the Oklahoma City Thunder, looking to prove that the Pacers still belong in conversations among the top teams in the Eastern Conference after their one down year. articles._body: Aaron Donald rose as a major topic ahead of NFL roster cutdown day . Many fans of the Los Angeles Rams wondered if the final 53 would feature the beloved franchise defensive legend. Now the three-time NFL Defensive Player of the Year has made it official Sunday in rejoining head coach Sean McVay and company. Even the Rams’ social media team retouched a past graphic for Donald. pic.twitter.com/fIAFPIm61f — Los Angeles Rams (@RamsNFL) August 30, 2026 Los Angeles pulled off one move to help clear room for Donald. The Rams and general manager Les Snead chose to waive seven-year veteran defensive tackle Larrell Murchison on Sunday morning. Murchison can still return to the franchise if he clears the waiver wire, but can join the practice squad. So now the Rams really ignite their Super Bowl hopes with Donald running it back. Especially with the big game taking place inside the “Rams House” of SoFi Stadium, where Donald also won his first and only Super Bowl ring. articles.title: It’s not just math and reading. Classroom devices deprive kids of skills needed in the AI future and how to be ‘fully human,’ education experts say
articles.summary: "Children don’t need school to become more like the digital world. They are already immersed in that world for much of the time outside school hours."
articles._body: As the new school year begins, the debate over digital versus analog learning rages on, while more school districts reconsider the role of devices in the classroom. That’s as test scores in math and reading tanked after schools ditched textbooks in favor of screens. But the effect of computers and tablets on education goes beyond the basics of the so-called three R’s. “Elementary school always taught more than reading and mathematics. Children learned how to wait for someone else’s idea to be expressed before sharing their own, to negotiate disagreements and explain their thinking,” University of Pennsylvania Graduate School of Education professor Sarah Schneider Kavanagh and University of Portland School of Education professor Katie A. Danielson wrote in a Washington Post op-ed earlier this month. Such lessons are actually a critical aspect of growing up, as children’s cognition has been shown to mature via person-to-person interactions, not just from receiving information, they added But classroom computers and adaptive software now provide individualized instruction to many students. While that offers benefits, Kavanagh and Danielson warned there are also trade-offs. For example, when students merely click through math lessons on their own instead of solving problems with classmates, they don’t hear different ways of thinking. That kind of collective learning is especially important in the era of AI as distinctly human skills like attention span, curiosity, judgment, empathy and collaboration become more valuable, Kavanagh and Danielson argued. “Children don’t need school to become more like the digital world,” the professors wrote. “They are already immersed in that world for much of the time outside school hours. They need a place designed for other aims, such as conversation instead of consumption and collaboration instead of personalization. That isn’t resisting the future; it’s preparing children to be fully human in it.” Computers and online learning saw steadily expanded use in classrooms for decades, then they became essential during COVID-19 lockdowns. But rather than revert to pre-pandemic ways afterward, schools continued to relying heavily on them. There’s now a growing backlash. According to one tally , lawmakers in at least 17 states had introduced or debated legislation related to devices or screens in classrooms as of July. And earlier this year, the nation’s second largest school district, Los Angeles Unified, banned in-school screen use for students in preschool through first grade and curbed screen time for older students. There’s growing evidence that devices not only hurt test scores but children’s ability to think . Earlier this year, in written testimony before the U.S. Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation, neuroscientist Jared Cooney Horvath said Gen Z is less cognitively capable than previous generations, despite its unprecedented access to technology. He said Gen Z is the first generation in modern history to score lower on standardized tests than the previous one, citing a stark correlation in scores and time spent on computers in school. While skills measured by these tests aren’t always indicative of intelligence, they are a reflection of cognitive capability, which Horvath said has been on the decline over the last decade or so. “We’re facing challenges more complex and far-reaching than any in human history—from overpopulation to evolving diseases to moral drift,” he told Fortune ‘s Sasha Rogelberg. “Now, more than ever, we need a generation able to grapple with nuance, hold multiple truths in tension, and creatively tackle problems that are stumping the greatest adult minds of today.” This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: 49ers cut linebacker acquired in Saints trade during preseason
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers added linebacker depth late in the preseason this year after making a trade with the New Orleans Saints. However, it appears that the individual’s time with the organization was short-lived, as he was a cut candidate on Sunday. Reports indicate that the 49ers cut Dei
articles._body: The San Francisco 49ers added linebacker depth late in the preseason this year after making a trade with the New Orleans Saints . However, it appears that the individual’s time with the organization was short-lived, as he was a cut candidate on Sunday. Reports indicate that the 49ers cut Deion Jones about a week after trading for him from the Saints, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. Jones will not be part of San Francisco’s 53-man roster for the 2026-27 campaign. “49ers released veteran linebacker Deion Jones, whom they acquired last week from the Saints,” Schefter reported. The 31-year-old linebacker is a former second-round pick of the Atlanta Falcons from the 2016 NFL Draft. He played his first six seasons in Atlanta, serving as a consistent starter for the club throughout. Jones then served as a backup option for the Cleveland Browns, Carolina Panthers, and Tampa Bay Buccaneers for the next four years. He appeared in 17 games for the Bucs last season, ending the campaign with 29 combined tackles (16 solo). After being traded to the 49ers by the Saints just to be let go, his future in the NFL is certainly questionable. San Francisco will likely rely on Fred Warner and Dre Greenlaw to lead the way in the linebacker room in the club’s 4-3 defense. Tatum Bethune and Luke Gifford appear locked in as the go-to backup options. It is not currently known how many linebackers Mike Shanahan and the coaching staff plan to keep on the roster. After a chaotic offseason, the 49ers will begin the new campaign with a Week 1 matchup on “Thursday Night Football” against the Los Angeles Rams. That contest is scheduled to kickoff at 8:35 p.m. on September 10. The post 49ers cut linebacker acquired in Saints trade during preseason appeared first on ClutchPoints .

During the 2025 season, he finished the campaign with one touchdown catch. “He appeared in five games each for San Francisco and Pittsburgh, catching four passes for 40 yards for the 49ers and 10 catches for 80 yards with a score for the Steelers,” NBC Sports added. Valdes-Scantling also has 219 career receptions. He was selected in the fifth round of the 2018 NFL Draft. His best NFL season came in 2020 with the Packers. That year, he posted a career-high 690 receiving yards with six touchdown catches. Dallas is making quite a few cuts to the roster on Sunday. Running back Jaydon Blue is also getting cut from the team, ESPN reported. The Cowboys had a tough 2025 season . Dallas missed the NFL Playoffs, after finishing the year with a 7-9-1 record. articles.title: KATSEYE Reveals Sophia’s Status for Upcoming Wildworld Tour Dates
articles.summary: The group leader’s hiatus was announced in early August.
articles._body: KATSEYE is giving its loyal EYEKONS an update on Sophia Laforteza’s status. On Sunday (Aug. 30), the international girl group took to social media to address whether its leader would appear at upcoming Wildworld Tour dates following the announcement of her hiatus in early August. Related KATSEYE’s Sophia Laforteza Is ‘Literally Doing Everything to Get Mentally Well,’ Her Mom Says KATSEYE Makes Brief Daisy Chain Fields Festival Appearance After Canceling Performance How Did KATSEYE’s ‘WILD’ Manage Such a Record-Setting First Week for the Group? “We would like to share an update regarding Sophia’s upcoming schedule,” KATSEYE wrote in a message on their Instagram Stories . “Sophia is focusing on her well-being, and the company remains fully committed to providing her with all the support and resources needed.” The message, which was also posted on Weverse and signed by HYBE and Geffen Records, went on to note that Sophia “will not be participating in the Wildworld Tour in Europe and the UK,” scheduled for Sept. 1 through Sept. 7. “We sincerely ask for EYEKONS’ warm understanding, as our highest priority will always be the health and long-term well-being of our artists,” the note continued. “We will share further updates as they become available. Please continue to send your love, warmth, and support to Sophia and KATSEYE.” Sophia’s break from KATSEYE was announced by HYBE x Geffen on Aug. 7, with the label confirming that she would temporarily step away from promotional activities to focus on her mental health and wellness. According to the company, Sophia had been receiving support and, following consultations with medical professionals, was advised to take an extended period of rest and ongoing care. Her condition was expected to be reassessed in September, according to the Los Angeles Times . Last week, Sophia’s mother, actress Carla Guevara-Laforteza, offered a glimpse into how her daughter is spending her time away from KATSEYE, noting that she has been keeping busy with decidedly more low-key activities while prioritizing her well-being. “At present, Sophia is on hiatus,” Guevara-Laforteza told Vogue Philippines . “She goes to Disneyland every day; she’s baking, she’s painting. She’s literally doing everything to get mentally well.” Sophia’s hiatus came shortly after fellow KATSEYE member Manon also stepped away from group activities in February to focus on her health and well-being. The remaining members — Lara, Daniela, Yoonchae and Megan — have continued promoting the group’s latest music, including a brief appearance at Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields festival on Aug. 29. KATSEYE has emerged as a breakout global pop group, recently achieving its first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with its EP WILD , which includes the Billboard Hot 100 tracks “Pinky Up” and “Gnarly.”

articles.summary: Hall of Fame point guard and former NBA star Jason Kidd never played on the same team with LeBron James despite their careers overlapping, but Kidd did get to coach the new Philadelphia 76ers star from 2019-2021 during the duo’s time with the Los Angeles Lakers. Jason Kidd is generally considered
articles._body: Hall of Fame point guard and former NBA star Jason Kidd never played on the same team with LeBron James despite their careers overlapping, but Kidd did get to coach the new Philadelphia 76ers star from 2019-2021 during the duo’s time with the Los Angeles Lakers. Jason Kidd is generally considered one of the greatest point guards of all time, and while LeBron James is not a true point guard in that sense, he has often taken on the role of lead playmaker. James has made the comparison between him and Kidd before, and Kidd also believes the 76ers’ star is the closest to him in terms of overall game. “I have talked about the Joker, but since you brought LeBron up, I would say LeBron’s game is … my game is it closest to LeBron, even though his game is at a different altitude,” Kidd said during an appearance on the All-Star Magazine show. “He has the ability to make plays for his teammates. His IQ, understanding what is going to happen before it happens, is extremely high. Those are the two players when you talk about passing, and just their basketball IQ.” When Kidd retired from the NBA following the 2012-13 season, he was third on the league’s all-time assists leaderboard behind only John Stockton and Chris Paul. But James is hot on his heels , currently at No. 4 on the list, and set to pass him this upcoming season. The 76ers star needs only 75 assists to move past Kidd into the No. 3 spot. Depending on how many games James plays next season, he will get very close to Chris Paul as well. James is 536 assists away from reaching Paul. He finished last season with 432 assists in 60 games. articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns are cutting the roster down to 53 players, and after announcing Deshaun Watson as the starting quarterback, expectations grew that the club would move on from at least one of the other QBs on the team. However, the club’s latest decision on rookie Taylen Green suggests
articles._body: The Cleveland Browns are cutting the roster down to 53 players, and after announcing Deshaun Watson as the starting quarterback, expectations grew that the club would move on from at least one of the other QBs on the team. However, the club’s latest decision on rookie Taylen Green suggests otherwise. Reports indicate that the Browns’ sixth-round pick has made the final 53-man roster , according to Mary Kay Cabot of Cleveland.com. That means Cleveland will maintain four quarterbacks on the roster with Watson, Shedeur Sanders, Dillon Gabriel, and Green. “ Browns QB Taylen Green has made the 53-man roster, source tells clevelanddotcom,” Cabot reported. Watson and Sanders will be at the top of the pecking order in the quarterback room. While the eight-year veteran is the starter, his past production in the last three years gives head coach Todd Monken every possible reason to give Watson a short leash. Meanwhile, Gabriel and Green will round out the back end of the depth chart. Dillon Gabriel had opportunities to prove himself as a possible starter for the Browns last season in his rookie year, but the former third-round pick failed to impress. Green, on the other hand, is an interesting prospect for the Browns. He played at Arkansas last season and proved to be a solid dual-threat option under center. After five years at the collegiate level (three with Boise State, two with Arkansas), Taylen Green entered the NFL with 9,662 passing yards, 2,405 rushing yards, and 94 total touchdowns (59 passing, 35 rushing) while owning a 60.1% completion percentage. The Browns will kick off the 2026-27 campaign with a Week 1 matchup on the road against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Cleveland will not have a home game until Week 3 when the club takes on the Carolina Panthers. The post Browns expected to roster 4 QBs after Taylen Green decision appeared first on ClutchPoints .

The Seahawks acquired Avery Smith in a trade with the Los Angeles Chargers, via Tom Pelissero of the Ringer. In return, Seattl
articles._body: The Seattle Seahawks have been tinkering with their cornerback room all offseason. As the 53-man roster deadline looms, the franchise has added another player to the mix. The Seahawks acquired Avery Smith in a trade with the Los Angeles Chargers, via Tom Pelissero of the Ringer. In return, Seattle dealt a 2027 sixth-round pick. Terrion Arnold was signed in free agency , as was Trevon Diggs. But Arnold won’t be eligible to play games until his legal situation is decided. And Diggs is no guarantee to make the team. To be fair, neither is Smith. But the fact the Seahawks were willing to give up draft compensation this close to the roster cutdown shows how highly they think of the cornerback. Smith signed with the Chargers as an undrafted free agent in 2026. He came to the league after spending all four of his collegiate seasons with Toledo, appearing in 51 games. Overall, the cornerback made 127 tackles, 26 pass break ups and three interceptions. He was named Second-team All-MAC in both 2024 and 2025. Smith got plenty of run with the Chargers throughout the preseason, looking to leave his mark. While he won’t be playing in Los Angeles, the cornerback certainly made an impression on Seattle. Now, assuming he makes the final roster, will be looking to make an impact as soon as possible. While the Seahawks are coming off of a Super Bowl title, they knew their franchise wasn’t perfect. Secondary help was identified as a key need. While Smith won’t turn the unit into world beaters on his own, he gives Seattle an interesting rookie to work with at cornerback. The Cardinals overcame an early 7-0 hole as their defense forced a pair of fumbles, which were converted into touchdowns. Will Levis, drafted No. 33 overall by the Tennessee Titans in 2023, has been waived after just three seasons with the franchise. Once seen as the future face
articles._body: One of the best quarterbacks in Kentucky football history will get the fresh start he undoubtedly needs after a difficult stint in Nashville. Will Levis, drafted No. 33 overall by the Tennessee Titans in 2023, has been waived after just three seasons with the franchise. Once seen as the future face of the organization, the Titans quickly moved on from their belief in the former Wildcat as their guy, drafting Cam Ward at No. 1 in 2025. Levis had a promising rookie campaign with flashes of brilliance, ultimately earning the starting job in November and going on to throw for 1,808 yards and eight touchdowns with just four interceptions in nine games. Taking over the full-time job in 2024, he led the league in turnovers with seven interceptions in his first five games, with the Titans going 1-4 in that stretch. Injuries and inconsistent play kept him in and out of the lineup the rest of the way, finishing the year with 2,091 passing yards, 13 touchdowns and 12 interceptions in 12 games. Tennessee GM Mike Borgonzi expressed belief in Levis as a long-term option for the franchise, only to turn around and take Ward shortly after, effectively ending his time as the starter. He underwent season-ending surgery in July, taking him out for all of 2025, followed by the Titans signing Mitchell Trubisky to compete with Levis as Ward’s backup entering 2026.

articles.title: Broncos’ Jonathon Cooper placed on commissioner’s exempt list for assault charges
articles.summary: Denver Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was arrested back in early June for an alleged domestic violence incident with his ex-girlfriend. After several weeks of the NFL conducting its own investigation while Cooper faces five assault charges, the league made a final decision on his status to be
articles._body: Denver Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was arrested back in early June for an alleged domestic violence incident with his ex-girlfriend. After several weeks of the NFL conducting its own investigation while Cooper faces five assault charges, the league made a final decision on his status to begin the new campaign. Reports indicate that the 28-year-old defender is being placed on the Commissioner’s Exempt List , according to Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. There is no set return date for Cooper at this time. “ The NFL is placing Broncos pass rusher [Jonathon] Cooper on the Commissioner’s Exempt List, taking him off the field because of two incidents involving a former girlfriend,” Rapoport reported. “Cooper faces five charges, including second-degree assault, which is a felony.” Cooper was initially arrested on June 4 due to an alleged altercation with his ex-girlfriend over a cell phone. The five-year pro was slapped with misdemeanor charges of criminal mischief and domestic violence for that incident. Jonathon Cooper was arrested again on June 11 for allegedly violating a protective order by visiting his former girlfriend’s home. The woman allegedly involved was initially given the same charges as Cooper. However, after further evaluation, prosecutors dismissed the charges against Cooper’s ex-girlfriend. The former seventh-round pick faces five total charges, including second-degree assault (strangulation), third-degree assault (causing injury), criminal mischief, violation of a protective order, and harassment. The 2026-27 campaign would be Jonathon Cooper’s sixth in the NFL. That will be put on hold for now while he spends time on the Commissioner’s Exempt List. He’s served as a consistent starter for the Broncos the past three seasons. He finished last year with 50 combined tackles (23 solo), eight sacks, and four pass deflections. articles.title: Kaleb Johnson trade grades for Packers, Steelers
articles.summary: As NFL teams attempt to trim their rosters down to 53 players, trades are flying around the league left and right. One such deal saw the Pittsburgh Steelers part with Kaleb Johnson. The details of the move are unconfirmed, but the trade sends the running back to the Green Bay Packers. The Packers
articles._body: As NFL teams attempt to trim their rosters down to 53 players , trades are flying around the league left and right. One such deal saw the Pittsburgh Steelers part with Kaleb Johnson. The details of the move are unconfirmed, but the trade sends the running back to the Green Bay Packers. The Packers had a dire need for running back insurance, and Pittsburgh was ready to cut their losses with an apparent draft bust. So, how do these two teams grade out for this trade? Steelers move on from Kaleb Johnson The Steelers drafted Johnson in the third round of the 2025 NFL Draft. Just over a year later, they’ve already given up on him. Expectations were high for the Iowa product heading into his rookie season after he was the sixth running back off the board, but he struggled mightily in year one. Johnson’s career got off to an immediately rough start, as he had a kickoff return blunder that allowed the opposing Seattle Seahawks to score a touchdown. Johnson never seemed to regain trust from the coaching staff, and he was only given 28 carries all season long, despite there being touches readily available in Pittsburgh’s backfield. Those 28 carries amounted to just 69 yards and 2.5 yards per carry. After a rough rookie season, Johnson’s case wasn’t helped when the Steelers went out and added Rico Dowdle and Travis Homer in free agency. The moves buried the still-young ball carrier down the depth chart and put him at risk of not making the team altogether, despite his status as a recent high draft pick. If Johnson truly wasn’t going to make the team because Pittsburgh couldn’t trust him as a returner or a running back, then they were smart to get something back in return. Even so, it is disappointing to see a team give up on a young player so quickly. Johnson was drafted with loads of potential just over a year ago, and while the Jaylen Warren-led backfield has some solid depth, it isn’t loaded with superstar talent. If the return is just a future late-round pick, the Steelers may have been better off giving Johnson one more chance. After all, rookie scale contracts are cheap, and players at the running back position take a beating, so having a second-year player with relatively fresh legs wouldn’t hurt at all. Grade: B- Packers add running back insurance Charles LeClaire-Imagn Images The Packers made the trade for Johnson just minutes before Josh Jacobs was added to the Commissioner Exempt list . Green Bay’s starting running back has made the Pro Bowl three times, but his future is in doubt because of misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property charges. Jacobs has a court date scheduled for Nov. 17 and is ineligible to play while on the list. Prison time and/or an NFL suspension are possibilities regarding Jacobs, and his future in the league is as murky as can be. The team didn’t have proven depth, though. Jacobs backups were Marshawn Lloyd, who has missed most of his first two seasons with injuries, and Chris Brooks, who only has 395 career rushing yards. With Johnson now on the roster, Green Bay can execute a backfield by committee if/when Jacobs is sidelined. Despite his rookie struggles, Johnson still has tons of potential and can live up to his third-round billing with a change of scenery. He is a physical ball carrier who thrives inside of the tackles. That complements Lloyd and Brooks nicely. The Packers needed running back help, and finding a young player, likely for cheap, was a great way to get it. Grade: A- The post Kaleb Johnson trade grades for Packers, Steelers appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Tennessee Titans waive QB Will Levis after three seasons
articles.summary: The Tennessee Titans waived former Kentucky quarterback Will Levis on Sunday, per NFL insider Ian Rapoport. Levis was a second round pick (No. 33 overall) in the 2023 NFL Draft by the Titans. Levis started 21 games for the Titans over the course of the last three years, but did not play last season
articles._body: The Tennessee Titans waived former Kentucky quarterback Will Levis on Sunday, per NFL insider Ian Rapoport. Levis was a second round pick (No. 33 overall) in the 2023 NFL Draft by the Titans. Levis started 21 games for the Titans over the course of the last three years, but did not play last season due to injury. Tennessee also drafted Cam Ward No. 1 overall in 2025, with the former Miami product winning the job and starting last season. Levis went 5-16 as a starter for the Titans, compiling 21 touchdowns, 16 interceptions, 3,899 yards and a 61% completion percentage. His struggles were evident, plus dealing with an injury derailed his time with the Titans and now he’ll look elsewhere to continue his career. “There are not 32 quarterbacks in this league better than me,” Levis told reporters at Titans training camp, via The Athletic , on August 3rd . “I know that for sure. I know I’ve put the tape out there already … “ know I’ve put the tape out there already that I’m a damn good quarterback in this league. And I’m even better than I ever have been.” During his time away from the game, Levis believed it was actually a blessing in disguise. Moving forward, we’ll see if he latches onto another team whether it’s a practice squad or emergency quarterback role. “I’m just focused on having fun,” Levis said. “I needed that time, not just physically, but just mentally to calm the nervous system. Where I’m at mentally is in a much healthier place than it’s ever been. I feel like I worked a lot for other people’s approval in the beginning of my career. And whereas I’m just trying to be the best version of me at this point.” Levis began his college career at Penn State in 2018 when he redshirted. In 2019 and ’20, he started just two games, going 1-1. In 2021, Levis showcased career high numbers with Kentucky after his transfer. In 2021, he threw for 2,826 yards, 24 touchdowns, 13 interceptions, a 66% completion percentage, 376 rushing yards and nine rushing touchdowns. All told, Levis had 5,876 yards, 46 touchdowns, 25 interceptions, a 64.9% completion percentage, 742 rushing yards and 17 rushing touchdowns.

articles.title: Show HN: AnVendor – see your competitor's customers
articles.summary:
Long story short: I found a way to reveal which SaaS any company uses. And estimate how much they pay for it.

And now in detail: I'm a solo entrepreneur – an ML Engineer, a bit of a product manager, and a self-taught marketer. At some point, I thought it would be nice to detect what services co
articles._body: Long story short: I found a way to reveal which SaaS any company uses. And estimate how much they pay for it. And now in detail: I'm a solo entrepreneur – an ML Engineer, a bit of a product manager, and a self-taught marketer. At some point, I thought it would be nice to detect what services companies use. There are solutions that scan websites for frameworks and APIs used, or that analyze a company's job postings, and others that look at news and website publications. But overall, no single approach can determine what SaaS services are being used right now. Only in the past or in the future. So I created an engine that does this (not right away, of course, but after almost six months of experimentation). Unfortunately, I can't go into detail about how it works; that's the main secret of my service. It's not hacking, cracking, or secret databases. It's just a little ingenuity. And there's absolutely no AI – just engineering and classic ML. The engine itself can only detect the fact of a "subscription" from any company. "Subscription" is in quotation marks because that's not entirely accurate – it's more likely that the company interacts with SaaS. Sometimes it might be a pilot, sometimes a parent or subsidiary company. Nevertheless, it works. To make this product useful for lead generation, I added a second layer – an estimate of how much the company spends on services. This collects service rates, the number of employees, and a bunch of other parameters, plus a cost estimation model. This is a rough estimate, as there are situations like pilots, special negotiating terms, and discounts for enterprises. However, this estimate will improve as more data is accumulated. Currently, I've added ~700 SaaS services that can be detected. And I really need a signal from real users about which services should be added – the service has a free plan, and all service requests are stored in the database. Overall, I'd appreciate any feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49501656 Points: 1 # Comments: 1

He spoke out after the injury move. “That’s obviously the biggest thing is, you know, dealing with pain kind of every day, tryin
articles._body: The St. Louis Cardinals got some tough news on Sunday, when star infielder JJ Wetherholt had to go on the injured list . Wetherholt is dealing with a wrist injury. He spoke out after the injury move. “That’s obviously the biggest thing is, you know, dealing with pain kind of every day, trying to find ways to manage that,” Wetherholt said, per MLB.com. “Some days are better than others. But yeah, you never want to be hurting when you swing, so it’s tough.” Wetherholt has been having an outstanding season . The young Cardinals slugger has 17 home runs, 48 RBIs, and 14 stolen bases. He is helping to pace the St. Louis offense, while hitting at a .242 batting average. Wetherholt has been receiving medical treatment, while trying to remain in the lineup for his team. The infielder admits it just wasn’t working. “My body just was not really responding to it,” Wetherholt said. “So the doctors said, ‘Yeah, we’re losing that pain battle, so, just kind of get some time.’” St. Louis is leaning on Wetherholt to help lift the team to the Major League Baseball Playoffs. The Redbirds are still alive in the chase for a Wild Card berth, in the National League. St. Louis is currently third in the NL Central. The Redbirds hope the young slugger gets the rest he needs. “We agreed to, if it wasn’t going to continue to improve, then we would hit the pause button,” Cardinals manager Oliver Marmol said. “We got to the point yesterday where it just didn’t feel good. So, we’ll give it the appropriate rest and then move forward from there.” St. Louis is in action on Sunday against the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cardinals are 68-69 on the campaign. articles.title: Most Important Players For Wisconsin in 2026: No. 5 Austin Kawecki
articles.summary: Oklahoma State transfer Austin Kawecki could be the key to elevating Wisconsin's offensive line play in 2026.
articles._body: MADISON, Wis. — Looking ahead to the 2026 season, Badger Blitz is counting down the 26 most important players for Wisconsin this fall. We continue with senior center Austin Kawecki , who should solidify a key position for the Badgers this season… 2025 Rewind Kawecki started all 12 games at Oklahoma State in 2025, including 11 starts at center. Over the past three seasons, Kawecki appeared in 25 games. According to Pro Football Focus, Kawecki posted a 63.9 overall grade in 2025. He played 710 snaps for OSU and featured a 76.8 pass-blocking grade. Kawecki allowed 2.0 sacks and 12 pressures on 394 pass-blocking snaps. In the transfer portal, Kawecki chose Wisconsin over South Carolina, Stanford, and a few other Big 12 programs. In high school, he had been recruited by both offensive coordinator Jeff Grimes and offensive line coach Eric Mateos . “We had a strong relationship in high school,” said Kawecki. “I really enjoyed spending time with them. When they came back around this time, I saw what they had done the past couple of years, the success they had — I wanted to be a part of that.” Why Kawecki is No. 5 The center spot has given Wisconsin fits over the past few years. When he was healthy, Jake Renfro did a nice job on the interior, but the Badgers couldn’t count on him staying healthy. Kawecki is also the only reliable center UW has. Simply put, the Badgers cannot afford to have Kawecki out this season. Things got better with the reserves as fall camp wore on, but Kawecki is the one proven, consistent, and experienced snapper. Badger Blitz sources raved about Kawecki’s leadership as early as March. Helping tie an offensive line that returns just two starters together, Kawecki’s impact on and off the field could be vital for a unit whose run game ranked No. 110 in rushing, No. 122 in yards per carry, and No. 125 in sack percentage last season “It’s the most important thing we did,” Mateos said of adding Kawecki in the transfer portal. “What’s maybe the negative of our group right now? We don’t have as many skins on the wall. We haven’t been in as many wars as maybe some other groups. To me, if you’re in that situation, you have to find a veteran center, a guy who has been in those, who can communicate, understands the calls and adjustments we’re making. “I have a veteran center who’s been in a lot of wars and is smart. I can maybe just tell him. I don’t have to tell everybody else, and then I don’t have other guys thinking about too many things. I’ve got the veteran, smart guy.” What They Said Wisconsin’s two returning starters on the offensive line are right guard Emerson Mandell and left guard Collin Cubberly . Mandell has missed fall camp entirely with a foot injury. Aside from those two, Kawecki is the only other UW offensive lineman with starting experience. “Kawecki is great, man,” said sophomore right tackle Kevin Heywood , who is one of two projected first-time starters up front. “He’s a very experienced guy, very smart dude. He just knows what to do and when to do it. He knows what everyone’s job is supposed to be. When you watch film with him, he can coach the tackles, guards — he can coach whatever.” “I think he’s a great addition to this room.”

articles.title: US Open Signs Exclusive Deal With Kalshi
articles.summary: Geoff Burke-Imagn Images
articles._body: As the US Open’s main draw got underway Sunday, Front Office Sports has learned the tournament secured a new exclusive prediction-market partner at the last minute: Kalshi. Effective immediately, Kalshi will be the exclusive prediction-market partner of the US Open, two sources tell FOS . Terms and parameters of the deal were not clear, but the agreement was not formally locked in until after last week’s qualifying rounds had concluded, the sources say. The US Open, which is owned and operated by the U.S. Tennis Association, did not originally intend to have a prediction-market deal in place for this year’s tournament, the sources say; in fact, in recent weeks it held discussions with multiple platforms, but talks centered around match-integrity concerns and potential partnerships for next year and beyond. However, new USTA CEO Craig Tiley, who joined the organization in February after more than a decade as CEO of Tennis Australia—the entity that puts on the Australian Open—played a major role in getting a deal done for this year’s tournament, sources tell FOS . One source says that an “unusual” aspect of the agreement is that the USTA is blocking any other prediction-market platforms from advertising in the facility or on TV, including across ESPN, where the tournament is being broadcast. Earlier on Sunday, Kalshi published a blog post about the tournament, saying its platform has Aryna Sabalenka as the favorite to win at 23%, with Coco Gauff and Iga Świątek as close contenders. That blog post included fine print saying “Kalshi is not affiliated with the U.S. Open or WTA.” As of early Sunday afternoon, roughly $1.5 million had been placed on who will be the women’s singles winner . Sources say the USTA went forward with this deal even though, as of last week, it hadn’t formally approved prediction markets as a category to partner with. As of Sunday afternoon, Kalshi did not appear on the US Open’s list of official partners . No traditional sportsbooks are listed as official partners either. The ATP Tour, which oversees the men’s professional tennis tour and rankings, has no direct role in operating the US Open, but it has separately weighed in on prediction-market regulation. In a comment letter sent to the Commodity Futures Trading Commission in April, it expressed support for the regulator’s proposed rules to govern sports-event contracts and offered “recommendations that we believe would strengthen [the proposed rules],” including a prohibition on event contracts related to player injuries and officiating decisions. Prediction Markets Sports Spree Despite ongoing questions about whether sports-event contracts are legal under a federal framework or must be regulated at the state level like traditional sports betting, prediction-market platforms have been jockeying for sports partnerships. Both Kalshi and Polymarket are official partners of the NHL, while Polymarket landed the overall deal with MLB and has an agreement with the Yankees that runs through the rest of this season. Kalshi has team-level deals with the NHL’s Blackhawks and MLB’s Giants, Braves, Padres, Red Sox, and Dodgers; the first prediction-market company to partner with an individual team was Novig with the Mets . Among the major pro U.S. sports leagues, the NFL and NBA remain holdouts. The NFL will not have any prediction-market deals in place when the regular season kicks off Sept. 9, while the NBA has been in talks with multiple platforms for over a year but has not yet formally embraced the industry . Kalshi and ESPN declined to comment. The USTA did not immediately offer comment. The post US Open Signs Exclusive Deal With Kalshi appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: Show HN: Cogram Studio – CAD and BIM workspace for humans and agents
articles.summary:
Hi HN,

Rick and Alex here, co-founders of Cogram. We’ve been making project-management software for architects and engineers since 2023, and are now experimenting with a second product.

Cogram Studio (studio.cogram.com) is a CAD and BIM workspace for AI agents to create three-dimensional mode
articles._body: Hi HN, Rick and Alex here, co-founders of Cogram. We’ve been making project-management software for architects and engineers since 2023, and are now experimenting with a second product. Cogram Studio (studio.cogram.com) is a CAD and BIM workspace for AI agents to create three-dimensional models and dimensioned drawings. Studio runs FreeCAD ( https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD ) 1.1 headlessly, using the OpenCASCADE ( https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT ) geometry kernel. It imports and exports STEP, IFC, STL, DXF and FCStd files. Studio exposes an MCP server, so you can operate it from Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or other agents. Tools cover scripting against FreeCAD, inspecting the model visually, CRUD operations on views, tables, and sheets, importing terrain, etc. Studio also provides a built-in agent based on Pi ( https://github.com/earendil-works/pi ) and a basic UI for 3D model inspection, measurement, view, table, and sheet creation. There are two ways to try it: 1. Bring your own agent. Point Codex or Claude Code at studio.cogram.com/skill.md and ask it to follow instructions there. This starts a one-hour Studio session and opens the modelling environment in your browser, connected to your agent. You need to confirm sign up only if you want to save the session. 2. Use Studio’s built-in agent. Submit a prompt at studio.cogram.com and sign up. You receive 50 free credits. Here are two models created by agents: - A simple bookshelf ( https://studio.cogram.com/view/shr_1agb21nd4 ) with two sheets - The Colosseum ( https://studio.cogram.com/view/shr_3tm32c64y ) [large, can take minutes to load], with two sheets showing dimensioned and annotated views. For now, Studio works best when you use it iteratively. If you ask an agent for a finished, complex model and “let it rip”, it may produce something that looks convincing but doesn't hold up to scrutiny. Agentic modelling feels roughly like where agentic programming was in 2024: useful for speeding up repetitive or bounded tasks but not yet reliable enough to complete long, complex jobs. Recent models have improved at CAD. We expect progress to accelerate as models become even better at reasoning across the different representations used in architecture and engineering: geometry, drawings, images, materials, physical constraints, specifications, regulations, code, etc. Early users and our own experience suggest that agents are already useful design collaborators. They can help with repetitive CAD work, fabrication options, part sourcing and cost estimates. We expect that as models improve, agents will be able to explore many different designs, run simulations, and check constraints across an entire project. CAD will become a shared workspace for humans and agents. Because design decisions made in CAD shape much of what is eventually built, even modest improvements could have wide effects. We’d love to hear your feedback and ideas if you give Studio a try. We’re also hiring across product, engineering and commercial roles. If you’re interested in working on interesting problems involving AI and the physical world, please take a look at our open positions at https://cogram.com/about#careers . articles.title: Astros’ Carlos Correa gets encouraging injury update ahead of next recovery step
articles.summary: The Houston Astros have been without Carlos Correa for several months as he’s been working his way back from a tendon tear in his left ankle. With the club making a push for the playoffs in the final stretch of the regular season, the veteran infielder received inspiring news in his latest
articles._body: The Houston Astros have been without Carlos Correa for several months as he’s been working his way back from a tendon tear in his left ankle. With the club making a push for the playoffs in the final stretch of the regular season, the veteran infielder received inspiring news in his latest injury update. Reports indicate that Correa will follow through with a check-up with a doctor on Tuesday, according to Brian McTaggart of MLB.com. Depending on the outcome of that visit, the 31-year-old could begin running the bases and sliding, which would be a big step in his road to recovery. “Espada said Carlos Correa has a four-month checkup with a doctor Tuesday, with hopes he could start running the bases and even [begin] sliding,” McTaggart reported. The injury completely derailed Correa’s season, as he’s only appeared in 32 games. His official return is still unknown, as it sounds like the 12-year vet still has plenty of work to do before he can play another game. Additionally, the Astros would want to give him some time to get back up to speed with a rehab assignment. His return would be a nice boost to the Astros’ offense, as Carlos Correa looked solid before sustaining the ankle injury. In 122 at-bats this year, the three-time All-Star has totaled 34 hits, three home runs, and 16 RBIs, giving him a .279 batting average and .369 OBP. The Astros have 26 games remaining on the schedule, including Sunday’s contest against the New York Mets. That’s the window Correa has to return and still have time to ramp up for the postseason, assuming Houston clinches the AL West. They are both named in the lawsuit in which the NCAA and SEC are named defendants. Ferguson and Olliviere are among the plaintiffs in a Louisiana lawsuit th
articles._body: LSU soccer players Jazmin Ferguson and Jocelyn Ollivierre , who are named in an eligibility lawsuit against the NCAA, entered a match on Sunday. They are both named in the lawsuit in which the NCAA and SEC are named defendants. Ferguson and Olliviere are among the plaintiffs in a Louisiana lawsuit that granted a group of athletes an additional year of eligibility. They were part of the 2022 recruiting class, which is at the center of multiple suits against the NCAA’s age-based, five-year eligibility model. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage Both players entered the match in the 21st minute on Sunday. In July, Tampa Bay Sun FC of the USL Super League announced Ferguson as part of its roster. LouisianaSports.net’s Matt Moscona first noted the two players went into the match against Arizona . Ferguson and Ollivierre are both named plaintiffs in the Louisiana lawsuit that includes former LSU EDGE Jack Pyburn . He was waived Sunday by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, and the documents revealed his plans to return to Baton Rouge next season and play for Lane Kiffin if he clears waivers. The SEC previously announced new rules in place for athletes attempting to return from the NFL, NBA and WNBA, but has said it plans to comply with the judge’s order. In an amended filing late last week, commissioner Greg Sankey – as well as the conference – were added as defendants. The NCAA’s age-based eligibility model has been at the center of the latest eligibility lawsuits. Athletes will get five years to play five seasons with their eligibility clock starting at the date they enroll in college or that of their 19th birthday, whichever happens first. However, the new rule is not retroactive for the Class of 2022, and the NCAA has made clear it has no plans to do so. As a result, athletes from the class have taken to court seeking a fifth year of eligibility. This story will be updated.

articles._body: Congratulations are in order for Finneas and his longtime love, Claudia Sulewski, who have officially tied the knot. The Grammy-winning singer and producer, 29, married the YouTuber, actress and CYKLAR Skincare founder, 30, at San Ysidro Ranch in Santa Barbara, California, on Saturday (Aug. 30), according to TMZ . Related Finneas and Longtime Girlfriend Claudia Sulewski Engaged After Seven Years of Dating Finneas to Keynote Guild of Music Supervisors’ 2026 State of Music in Media Conference Billie Eilish’s ‘Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour’ Film Hits Streaming This Week The intimate ceremony was officiated by Finneas’ superstar sister and longtime musical collaborator, Billie Eilish . Their parents, Maggie Baird and Patrick O’Connell, were also there to watch their son exchange vows. The couple celebrated with family, celebrity friends and their dogs, Peaches and Moose. Among the famous guests were Justin and Hailey Bieber, Rachel Sennott, Emma Chamberlain, Rebecca Black, Jason Sudeikis, Kristen Bell, Dax Shepard, Devon Lee Carlson, Stassie Karanikolaou and Jesse Jo Stark. Eilish also attended with her boyfriend, Nat Wolff. For the special occasion, Sulewski wore four Oscar de la Renta looks throughout the wedding weekend: one for the rehearsal dinner, one for the ceremony and first dance, one for the reception and one for the after-party, according to Vogue . Finneas and Sulewski announced their engagement in September 2025 after seven years together, sharing an Instagram post captioned “forever and ever 9.22.” The gallery opened with a photo of the couple hugging on a hillside at sunset, followed by a selfie of the two sharing a sweet kiss and another showing Finneas getting down on one knee to propose. The pair met on a dating app in 2018, with Finneas telling BuzzFeed in 2019 that he wrote a song in her honor, “Claudia,” within hours of meeting her. “I wrote the song Claudia about Claudia the day that I met Claudia, and I sent it to her the night that I met Claudia,” he said at the time. “I sent her the first part and she texted me back, ‘You’re trouble.’ And then the chorus, which is the, ‘I’m in trouble now’ part. I was like, ‘Oh, that’s… cheers!’” Since then, the lovebirds have also collaborated creatively, including on his 2022 solo song “Mona Lisa, Mona Lisa,” whose intimate video Sulewski starred in and directed.

articles.summary: If the San Antonio Spurs superstar Victor Wembanyama’s first three seasons in the NBA are anything to go by, there is not much that the French phenom cannot do. The reigning DPOY is very likely to continue to win major plaudits in the coming seasons, and according to Tony Parker, the Spurs are no
articles._body: If the San Antonio Spurs superstar Victor Wembanyama’s first three seasons in the NBA are anything to go by, there is not much that the French phenom cannot do. The reigning DPOY is very likely to continue to win major plaudits in the coming seasons, and according to Tony Parker, the Spurs are not the only team that will reap the benefits. Per Inquirer, the Spurs legend initially claimed that it was only a matter of time before Wemby will win the championship with San Antonio. “The potential is amazing. You know, I think it’s just a matter of time before they win the championship,” he said. However, when asked about France, Parker claimed that it was the same thing for his national team. “Same thing. I hope we get a lot of gold medals. I think we have a very, very good team. And now we just have to keep working hard,” he proclaimed. There is little doubt that Wembanyama has earned the right to be counted among the NBA’s elite stars in only his fourth season in the league. Wemby averaged 25 points, 11.5 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 3.1 blocks per game last season and led the Spurs all the way to the NBA Finals. San Antonio have reacted quickly to his rise and surrounded Wembanyama with the right players that fit his timeline. They now have a young core comprising of superstars such as De’Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper, all players who are in a similar age group and are only going to get better in the coming seasons. They moved quickly in order to add depth and experience this offseason, signing Tobias Harris and drafting multiple stars who can be expected to be a major part of the rotation next season. Wembanyama himself will be looking to land his first MVP title, and not many will question his ability to continue in the same vein.     The post Tony Parker makes Victor Wembanyama, Spurs prediction that won’t surprise anybody appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Packers RB Josh Jacobs placed on commissioner’s exempt list after misdemeanor charges
articles.summary: The Green Bay Packers have been active on 2026 roster cutdown day. Green Bay already made a few important transactions, including shipping Kyle McCord to Miami. The Packers just got some huge news surrounding Josh Jacobs’ legal situation that puts the team in a bind ahead of Week 1. Jacobs
articles._body: The Green Bay Packers have been active on 2026 roster cutdown day . Green Bay already made a few important transactions, including shipping Kyle McCord to Miami. The Packers just got some huge news surrounding Josh Jacobs’ legal situation that puts the team in a bind ahead of Week 1. Jacobs has been placed on the commissioner’s exempt list , per ESPN’s Adam Schefter. He is now ineligible to play while the NFL investigates his off-the-field situation. Jacobs was arrested on domestic abuse charges back in May. He was then charged with misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property on August 27th. That development put Jacobs’ availability for the start of the 2026 season, and his future with the Packers, into question. Jacobs’ lawyers released a statement on his behalf after the news broke on Sunday. “Josh Jacobs has been placed on the Commissioner’s Exempt List, which is an administrative procedure used by the NFL while a matter is being reviewed,” the statement read, per NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport. “It is not a final determination. Josh respects the NFL process, the Packers, and his Coaches and Teammates. He looks forward to his return to the team and the NFL.” Green Bay is now set to enter the regular season without Jacobs and superstar pass rusher Micah Parsons. That puts them down one significant player on each side of the football. The Packers acquired Kaleb Johnson from the Steelers with some form of discipline for Jacobs looking likely. Johnson will compete with MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks for snaps while Jacobs remains on the exempt list. The Packers open the regular season with a road game against the Vikings. That NFC North clash kicks off at 4:25PM ET on September 13th from U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis. articles.summary: With the Los Angeles Dodgers postponing Shohei Ohtani’s pitching return, originally believed to happen Sunday against the Detroit Tigers, the plan now shifts to when his next opportunity is and what his role would look like. As the Dodgers remain undecided about Ohtani’s pitching role
articles._body: With the Los Angeles Dodgers postponing Shohei Ohtani’s pitching return , originally believed to happen Sunday against the Detroit Tigers, the plan now shifts to when his next opportunity is and what his role would look like. As the Dodgers remain undecided about Ohtani’s pitching role, this MLB insider potentially teases that a change of role could be at play. Speaking with SportsCenter, ESPN’s Buster Olney would speak about where the situation is with Los Angeles and Ohtani, who hasn’t pitched since July 3. With it at a “crossroads” due to Ohtani’s left knee that has continually delayed any return to the mound, Olney would say that the team has to talk with the star about a possible “bullpen role.” “This situation has reached a crossroads because every time he tries to ramp up with his pitching, that left knee, the land knee for a right-handed pitcher, is a problem,” Olney said. “And so the Dodgers have to talk with Ohtani about if he’s open to a bullpen role because there might not be enough time for him to ramp up the pitches he needs to be a starting pitcher.” "[The Dodgers] do really need him with their offense." @Buster_ESPN details Shohei Ohtani's timeline to return to the field pic.twitter.com/UDR6MsQpcl — SportsCenter (@SportsCenter) August 30, 2026 Should the Dodgers prioritize Shohei Ohtani’s pitching return? While the left knee has held back Ohtani from pitching with the Dodgers, as he’s recorded a 1.79 ERA with 95 strikeouts and an 8-2 record in 14 starts, it hasn’t impacted his offense. Currently with a .283 batting average with 30 home runs and 80 RBIs, Olney would argue that Los Angeles might not need Ohtani’s pitching, as the offense is the biggest problem at the moment. “And here’s the reality of the situation: the Dodgers don’t really need him on their pitching staff because of all that depth with Tarik Skubal and [Yoshinobu] Yamamoto and [Blake] Snell and [Tyler] Glasnow,” Olney continued. “They do really need him with their offense, which has been struggling so badly since the All-Star break, the Dodgers rank 22nd in runs. They rank 18th in home runs; And so, if you’re the Dodgers, you might want him to prioritize hitting.” It remains to be seen when Ohtani pitches again for the Dodgers. articles.title: World mostly shrugs off Bessent’s ‘D-Day’ Iran sanctions threat
articles.summary: Iranian bank branches remained open in Dubai. Commercial flights also continued between Iran and Turkey as well as Iran and the United Arab Emirates.
articles._body: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent began the week vowing an “economic onslaught” against Iran and its trading partners in a fresh bid to end the war. By the week’s end, countries with ties to Tehran had so far shrugged off the threat and analysts were left underwhelmed by the US actions. China, which buys 90% of Iran’s oil, issued a  defiant warning  to Washington rather than back down. Iranian bank branches remained open in Dubai. At one Bank Melli branch in Abu Dhabi, staff were busy typing away and one employee explained that they were still open for business.  Commercial flights also continued between Iran and Turkey as well as Iran and the United Arab Emirates, which had promised last week to sever all trade and financial transactions with Tehran. Routes flying to Thailand and Azerbaijan, as well as multiple destinations in both Russia and China, remained unaffected. As the week came to a close, the US announced plans to sanction the UAE-based branches of Egypt’s Banque Misr. That fell well below expectations after Bessent’s warning that the world would see “a major announcement of a financial institution being sanctioned by the end of this week.” “As the war passes the six-month mark, the public actions taken by the Treasury Department this week do not match the hype,” said Alex Zerden, a former US Treasury official and founder of Capitol Peak Strategies.  “Operation Economic Outcast is a continuation of 47 years of restrictive economic measures against Iran but does not provide a clearer theory of economic or military victory in this current campaign,” Zerden said. The Treasury Department didn’t respond to a request for comment on Friday. Bessent’s threats — and the collective global shrug so far — underscore the Trump administration’s main conundrum as it seeks to sanction Iran into meeting its demands. Any effective sanctions campaign would need to hit China, a move that risks sparking retaliation and potentially massive global economic fallout. Anything less would add to Iran’s economic pain but not enough to budge its strategic calculus. US credibility is also at stake. Bessent repeatedly compared the US response to the historic 1944 D-Day landings in Normandy, France — a coordinated land and air invasion aimed at toppling the Nazi regime. But the US acted unilaterally with its latest move, pressuring other countries rather than working with them, and Bessent openly acknowledged that going too fast and too hard risked tanking the global financial system. Read More:  US Moves Against Egyptian Bank’s UAE Branches Over Iran Ties Further muddying the picture, Bessent also said the US was engaged in “quiet diplomacy” to get its way. US officials turned to counterparts in the UK asking for a  statement  of support, according to people familiar with the matter.  The Treasury chief is also expected to speak with fellow finance ministers this weekend at a Group of 20 gathering in Asheville, North Carolina. One of the biggest questions attendees will likely have for Bessent is whether the US is willing to hit a Chinese financial institution, according to Josh Lipsky, chair of international economics at the Atlantic Council.  The UAE, a key US strategic ally,  said  earlier this month it would cut financial ties with Iran. But some flight and banking links with Tehran appear to continue, and the UAE’s government described its move in a statement to Bloomberg News as a “sovereign decision reflecting its strategic assessment of the national interest and the requirements of regional security.” Asked on Thursday which countries the US had approached so far, President Donald Trump responded, “about Iran? There’s not a lot to speak to. We don’t want to speak to them. We’re not looking to meet or anything.” “You can’t unleash meaningful economic warfare on Iran while ignoring the one country that absorbs 90% of its oil exports,” said Leland Miller, the CEO of  China Beige Book  data platform and a commissioner on the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission, which advises the US Congress. In the meantime, the US appears no closer to ending the war that Trump launched alongside Israel in late February. Iran has endured decades of harsh sanctions and has recently faced a full US Navy blockade of its ports that has dried up oil exports. Officials in nations that have traditionally had strong economic links with Iran have not heard much from the US this week. Turkey has not received any formal guidance from the US on the restrictions and how they apply to Iran, according to people familiar with the matter. But they believe they’ll have adequate time to discuss and implement requirements once they are informed, they said. The response from Pakistan indicated that even countries with close ties to the US are feeling little immediate pressure from the new campaign, at least so far.  While Islamabad has won praise from Trump for its mediation efforts to end the war, there was no indication that its overland trade with the Islamic Republic — such as in rice and mangoes — had slowed down. Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry spokesman Tahir Andrabi told reporters this week that the country “is not obliged” to respond to unilateral sanctions. “The idea Iran can be knocked out with this is risible — it’s not going to move the needle,” said Stephen Fallon, principal adviser at DBM Consulting. “It’s not possible to get a completely airtight seal on this thing. There are too many actors, and it’s too rewarding for the people involved.” This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.summary: The UCLA Women's Volleyball team completed a home-and-home sweep of Long Beach State, winning in straight sets at Pauley Pavilion on Saturday night 25-21, 30-28, 25-16 one day after beating the 49ers in Long Beach in four sets.  Saturday's victory marked the first home win for first-year coach Matt
articles._body: The UCLA Women’s Volleyball team completed a home-and-dfhome sweep of Long Beach State, winning in straight sets at Pauley Pavilion on Saturday night 25-21, 30-28, 25-16 one day after beating the 49ers in Long Beach in four sets. Saturday’s victory marked the first home win for first-year coach Matt Werle and improved the team’s record to 2-0. Freshman middle blocker Brooke Harwood led the Bruins with 13 kills, hitting .500 and sophomore transfer outside hitter Ava Utterback was also in double digits with 11 kills to go along with 6 digs. Junior setter Kate Duffey ran the offense, notching a double-double with 35 assists and 12 digs. Libero Lola Schumacher led the team in the back row, getting a team-high 13 digs and adding 4 assists. After winning the first set relatively easily, the second set proved to be a marathon. UCLA had multiple shots at set point, and finally prevailed at 30-28 after 11 ties and 4 lead changes. Coach Werle briefly inserted transfer setter Ava Sarafa to change up the momentum, and Duffey eventually returned to close out the set. In the final set, the Bruins’ relentless offensive attack and stout blocking eventually wore down Long Beach, as the home team prevailed in the final set going away. The Bruins notched 25 blocks in the match, compared to just 10 for Long Beach and outhit the visitors .232 to .148. The Bruins next 11 matches are all on the road or at neutral sites. Their next match will be against third-ranked Kentucky in Lexington. They open Big 10 play on September 24th in Indiana and their next home match is on October 2nd against Michigan State. Here are some photos from Saturday’s match: Sophomore Ava Utterback shows off her athleticism in her first home match as a Bruin. Freshman Brooke Harwood hits over the Long Beach block, including UCLA beach volleyball alumna Reagan Hope (24). Harwood matched her jersey number with 13 kills on the night. Junior setter Kate Duffey makes a tight set at the net after chasing down an errant pass. Duffey led the team with 35 assists. Senior middle blocker Marianna Singletary was her usual dominant self at the net, garnering 9 kills and 8 blocks. Senior outside hitter Maggie Li had 6 kills and 10 digs Sophomore Eliana Urzua had 8 kills and added 5 blocks at the net for the Bruins The players on the sidelines doing some mid-match push-ups Freshman DS/L Presley Thompson has made her way into the rotation with some outstanding back row play and solid serving Junior all-conference libero Lola Schumacher can always be counted on to bring the excitement and spirit to the team Long Beach’s Reagan Hope (center) was a member of the UCLA Beach Volleyball team from 2023 to 2025. Ava Utterback was fearless with the big swings on the left side of the net. Setter Kate Duffey gets in a joust with Long Beach’s Kyler Birkelbach Marianna Singletary causing havoc at the net Maggie Li and Ava Utterback celebrate a kill with a group hug The whole team celebrates the win after completing the 3-0 sweep. Next up, Kentucky. articles.summary: The Memphis football team got the Charles Huff era started with a big win over UNLV. Memphis defeated UNLV on Saturday, 27-21. A college football insider is making a bold prediction about Memphis head coach Huff. “Charles Huff won’t be at Memphis for long. Wins everywhere. And last night wa
articles._body: The Memphis football team got the Charles Huff era started with a big win over UNLV. Memphis defeated UNLV on Saturday, 27-21. A college football insider is making a bold prediction about Memphis head coach Huff. “Charles Huff won’t be at Memphis for long. Wins everywhere. And last night was a jewel,” CBS Sports college football insider Brad Crawford posted to X, formerly Twitter. Huff is in his first season at Memphis. He previously had successful stints with Marshall and Southern Miss. Huff made a bold statement after his Tigers defeated UNLV. “This was a national statement,” Huff said, per Underdog Dynasty. “Not just about the score and not just about the game. But that the Memphis Tiger community is serious about this program and the direction this program is going. This was just one game, but the momentum it created, the statement that it’s making is huge.” The Memphis head coach said there are specific reasons why his guys were so fired up to play. “We’re a fourth quarter program,” Huff said. “That starts in January. When everybody else is just tag-touching a cone and feeling really good about themselves, we’re taking them into the deep water. That’s our process. We plan to win the game in the fourth quarter because we work harder than a lot of other teams.” Huff wants to set a championship culture at Memphis . The Tigers are trying to get into a power 4 conference. Memphis had previously made an unsuccessful bid to join the Big 12. “We’re Memphis,” Huff said. “Everything about our community that everything tries to tear down, we’re not. And selling the stadium out next week will make another national statement. We’ve got to improve football-wise — don’t get me wrong — but if we keep making the strides from continuity and community support, we can get to where we’re trying to go… Hopefully everyone can see that everything is aligning at Memphis.” The Tigers next play Arkansas State on September 5. articles.title: Josh Jacobs placed on commissioner exempt list in light of formal charges related to May arrest
articles.summary: Josh Jacobs has been placed on the commissioner exempt list by the NFL, the league announced Sunday. The decision comes in light of formal charges related to his May arrest, which came down earlier this week. Earlier this week, Jacobs was formally charged with misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor cri
articles._body: Josh Jac obs has been placed on the commissioner exempt list by the NFL, the league announced Sunday. The decision comes in light of formal charges related to his May arrest, which came down earlier this week. Earlier this week, Jacobs was formally charged with misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor criminal damage to property in connection with the arrest. If convicted, Jacobs is facing a fine of not more than $10,000 or not more than nine months in prison, or both, according to ESPN . He has a court date scheduled for Nov. 17. In light of the arrest, there were questions about what type of action the NFL could take against Jacobs. By going on the commissioner exempt list, Jacobs cannot practice or play for the Packers, according to league rules. “The National Football League today placed Josh Jacobs of the Green Bay Packers on the Commissioner Exempt List,” the NFL announced Sunday afternoon. “Jacobs may not practice or attend games while on the list.” Jacobs’ attorneys also released a statement on the NFL’s decision. The league is still reviewing the situation and the move to the commissioner exempt list is not necessarily a final ruling, they also noted. “Josh Jacobs has been placed on the Commissioner’s Exempt List, which is an administrative procedure used by the NFL while a matter is being reviewed,” the statement read . “It is not a final determination. Josh respects the NFL process, the Packers, and his Coaches and Teammates. He looks forward to his return to the team and the NFL.” Late last week, Packers coach Matt LaFleur addressed Jacobs’ situation in light of the charges that came down against him. He told reporters he expects Jacobs to remain on the roster this season while also stressing the need to let things unfold. “You’ve got to let everything play out,” LaFleur said during a Friday press conference ahead of the Packers’ preseason finale against the Arizona Cardinals. “But I anticipate him being a member of our football team.” The NFL’s announcement comes after the Packers traded for Pittsburgh Steelers running back Kaleb Johnson . He appeared in 10 games during his lone season with the Steelers. During that time, he took 28 carries for 69 yards in Arthur Smith’s offense. He also had one reception for nine yards while also taking eight kick returns back for 190 yards.

articles.title: Google Maps changes Lake Ontario label to Lake America in U.S.
articles.summary: The decision was prompted by a change in the official US government geographic naming system, the company said.
articles._body: Google Maps relabeled Lake Ontario as “Lake America” for users in the US, Alphabet Inc. announced, after President Donald Trump said he would rename the lake amid a trade spat with Canada. The decision was prompted by a change in the official US government geographic naming system, the company said.  The lake is one of the Great Lakes and spans the border between the two countries. Trump clashed with New York Governor Kathy Hochul after she said that  New York state wouldn’t use the new name .  Users in Canada will continue to see the body of water labeled as Lake Ontario, while the rest of the world will see both names displayed. “These updates follow our long-standing policy for bodies of water with names that vary from country to country,” Alphabet said in a statement.  MapQuest will not change the name in its products, the platform wrote in a  social media post . Apple Maps is currently displaying the body of water to US users as Lake Ontario. Trump last year ordered the Gulf of Mexico renamed to Gulf of America.  This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Why Celtics’ Joe Mazzulla wants to be ‘forgotten’ after coaching career
articles.summary: The Boston Celtics are less than two months away from kicking off the 2026-27 NBA season with a very different roster than the one that choked a 3-1 lead last year to the Philadelphia 76ers. Jaylen Brown is now a member of those 76ers, with Paul George coming back to Boston, putting the pressure
articles._body: The Boston Celtics are less than two months away from kicking off the 2026-27 NBA season with a very different roster than the one that choked a 3-1 lead last year to the Philadelphia 76ers. Jaylen Brown is now a member of those 76ers, with Paul George coming back to Boston, putting the pressure on head coach Joe Mazzulla to make things work with new faces in town. Recently, Mazzulla spoke on what he hopes his legacy will be in the Boston sports world. “If the people around you didn’t do what they do… I wouldn’t do anything. The thing I reflect on the most is… I think you have to be willing to be forgotten. I think that’s kind of my main goal. “I want to be forgotten about. Because that means after you… It was better. I think that’s what it means to be a Celtic. However long you play, coach, work for the Celtics…” said Mazzulla, per Josh Chambers of Maryland Men’s Basketball on X, formerly Twitter. Mazzulla earned the NBA Coach of the Year award for his performance in leading the Celtics to the second seed in the Eastern Conference last year in what many expected to be a gap season. However, for the second straight year, Mazzulla’s philosophy of having the Celtics launch threes at all costs, with little semblance of a backup plan, crashed and burned in the playoffs when Boston went cold at the wrong time, losing three straight games to the 76ers to go home in the first round for the first time in five years. Now, Mazzulla will look to double down and prove that he is still one of the NBA’s elite, even if he doesn’t want anyone to remember it.
