articles.title: Eagles waive receiver ahead of NFL season
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles waived wide receiver Samori Toure on Saturday as the team begins its final roster cutdown ahead of the 2026 NFL season. Philadelphia must reduce their roster to 53 players by 6 p.m. Sunday, with Toure now subject to the waiver process through Monday. Toure joined the Eagle
articles._body: The Philadelphia Eagles waived wide receiver Samori Toure on Saturday as the team begins its final roster cutdown ahead of the 2026 NFL season. Philadelphia must reduce their roster to 53 players by 6 p.m. Sunday, with Toure now subject to the waiver process through Monday. Toure joined the Eagles on June 1, 2026 , but his bid for a roster spot ended before the team’s 53-man deadline. The 28-year-old receiver faced competition from DeVonta Smith, first-round rookie Makai Lemon, Dontayvion Wicks, Hollywood Brown and Elijah Moore, who occupied prominent positions in Philadelphia’s receiving group. Originally selected by the Green Bay Packers in the seventh round of the 2022 NFL Draft with the 258th overall pick, Toure made Green Bay’s initial 53-man roster as a rookie . He was inactive for the first six games before making his NFL debut in Week 7 against the Washington Commanders, catching one pass for four yards. The following week, he recorded his first NFL touchdown on a 37-yard reception from Aaron Rodgers against the Buffalo Bills. Across 22 regular-season games with the Packers, Toure recorded 13 receptions for 160 yards and one touchdown. He was placed on injured reserve on January 1, 2024, and was released by Green Bay on August 27 of that year. Toure subsequently spent time with the Chicago Bears, Denver Broncos and New Orleans Saints. Chicago initially added him to its practice squad before signing him to a reserve/future contract, while Denver and New Orleans also used him on their practice squads. With the Saints in 2025, he appeared in one game and caught one pass for three yards. If Toure clears waivers, he will become a free agent and can sign with another team’s 53-man roster or practice squad. He also made several plays during the Eagles’ training camp, making him a potential practice squad candidate. The post Eagles waive receiver ahead of NFL season appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: The Athletic predicts J.J. McCarthy won’t make Minnesota Vikings roster
articles.summary: The Athletic’s Alec Lewis provided his Minnesota Vikings 53-man roster projection and QB J.J. McCarthy did not make the cut. The former No. 10 overall pick in 2024 could find himself out of Minnesota after more injuries and a lackluster preseason. The ex-Michigan signal caller missed his entire rook
articles._body: The Athletic’s Alec Lewis provided his Minnesota Vikings 53-man roster projection and QB J.J. McCarthy did not make the cut. The former No. 10 overall pick in 2024 could find himself out of Minnesota after more injuries and a lackluster preseason. The ex- Michigan signal caller missed his entire rookie season due to a torn ACL and started just 10 games, going 6-4, in 2025. But after McCarthy lost the starting job in training camp to veteran Kyler Murray , who’s on a prove-it deal with the Vikings, McCarthy has steadily fallen down the depth chart. As Lewis puts it, there might only be room for two quarterbacks going into 2026. That’d be Murray and fellow veteran Carson Wentz , who went 2-3 in five starts for the Vikings before a season-ending injury last year. “McCarthy’s rough week added further murkiness about his status for 2026,” Lewis wrote . “The 23-year-old exited the second preseason game with an ankle injury, then practiced Monday and Tuesday. (Head coach Kevin) O’Connell gave him the day off Wednesday so that he could rest up enough to start Friday’s final preseason matchup with the Broncos.  “But McCarthy did not play. Wentz started and appears to be in line to be the team’s backup. McCarthy’s comfort (or lack thereof) with being QB3 could dictate his future in Minnesota.” As far as what McCarthy said what was going through his head when he lost the starting job, it was out of his control. Although he said the right thing about staying ready if needed by the Vikings. “A decision was made that was out of my control,” McCarthy said . “Obviously, everyone wants to play. Moving forward, it’s about continuing to work hard and stay ready for when my number is called.” J.J. McCarthy done in Minnesota? Last year, McCarthy threw for 1,632 yards, 11 touchdowns, 12 interceptions, a 57.6% completion percentage, 181 rushing yards and four rushing touchdowns. A national champion at Michigan, Vikings fans hoped for more out of McCarthy, who was picked over Sam Darnold following the 2024 season. Of course hindsight is 20-20, but Darnold went from having a career year in Minnesota to following it up with another solid campaign statistically and winning a Super Bowl for the Seattle Seahawks . It remains to be seen if McCarthy is kept on the roster behind Murray and presumably Wentz. While there was speculation he could be traded, if the Vikings are intent on parting ways, he’ll be an intriguing waiver or free agent pickup. Murray was previously released from the Arizona Cardinals to begin the new league year. He was quickly linked to the Vikings, and 24 hours later, he found his next NFL home, at least for the 2026 season. His play will determine what happens next. Regardless, Murray will be given ample opportunity to succeed in purple and gold. He spent all seven of his NFL seasons so far with Arizona, and across those seven years, Murray recorded 20,460 passing yards and 121 passing touchdowns. Both stats are good for third most in team history.

articles.title: Dodgers superstar Tarik Skubal gets 100% real after making start vs. Tigers in Detroit
articles.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers ace Tarik Skubal returned to Comerica Park on Friday to face the Detroit Tigers for the first time. It marked his 78th career appearance at the ballpark and his first there as a visitor. The start came less than a month before Detroit agreed to trade Skubal to Los Angeles on A
articles._body: Los Angeles Dodgers ace Tarik Skubal returned to Comerica Park on Friday to face the Detroit Tigers for the first time. It marked his 78th career appearance at the ballpark and his first there as a visitor. The start came less than a month before Detroit agreed to trade Skubal to Los Angeles on August 1. The back-to-back American League Cy Young Award winner had spent his entire professional career in the Tigers organization after the club drafted him in 2018. Skubal allowed one run on four hits across six innings in the Dodgers’ 2-1 victory. He struck out seven, issued no walks, and threw 83 pitches as Los Angeles ended a three-game losing streak. SportsNet LA shared a video Saturday on its official X account, formerly Twitter, from Skubal’s postgame interview after his return. “We’ll have a relationship for the rest of my life.” Tarik Skubal reflects on last night's return to Detroit: "We'll have a relationship for the rest of my life." pic.twitter.com/1WmGeJR32k — SportsNet LA (@SportsNetLA) August 29, 2026 The southpaw made the remark while discussing Tigers pitching coach Chris Fetter, who pushed him, simplified the game, and strengthened his confidence. Their families became close during Skubal’s time in Detroit, adding another personal dimension to his departure. A pregame tribute video brought Skubal to tears before he took the familiar mound in a visiting uniform. He had expected to treat the outing like a normal start, but the return carried more emotion than he anticipated. After the game, Skubal went home, ate a burger with his wife, and spent time with his son before going to sleep. The quiet routine helped him process the night. The families later looked through photographs of their sons together. Miguel Rojas tied the game with a pinch-hit RBI single in the sixth inning before Freddie Freeman delivered the go-ahead single in the eighth. Detroit acquired outfielder Zyhir Hope and right-handers River Ryan and Brady Smith in exchange for Skubal. Although the trade separated Skubal from the organization that developed him, his comments showed that the relationships he formed with the Tigers remain intact. Boone would say that it’ll be beneficial for McMahon to get some at-bats in the minor leagues before coming back to the team from the thumb injury. “We figure while he’s ready to go, he’ll get some at-bats and a game in and then he’ll fly with us to California,” Boone said, via MLB.com. articles.title: Natasha Cloud Calls WNBA Culture War an ‘Intentional Distraction’
articles.summary: Robert Edwards-Imagn Images
articles._body: NEW YORK — Natasha Cloud did not want to speak specifically about her verbal altercation with Enes Kanter Freedom. That, however, didn’t stop her from addressing the topic at large. “I won’t be talking about anything that will happen with an irrelevant person,” Cloud said Saturday ahead of the team’s game against the New York Liberty, her first time speaking to the media since Sunday’s altercation with the former NBA player in Chicago. Cloud said she would rather speak about issues that “actually affect women and children,” listing out sexual assault, food insecurity, and the ongoing war in the Middle East as some examples. “There’s so many other things that we can focus on that actually have immediate impact on women and children that we say we’re trying to protect right now, that we are being distracted,” Cloud said. The WNBA has been in the middle of a culture war in recent weeks surrounding gender eligibility , specifically about trans women playing the sport. It started after ESPN published an article in July where Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham said she wants to “protect young girls in a locker room, or young girls in sport who shouldn’t have to go against biological men.” Since then, Freedom is one of two former NBA players (along with Royce White) that have declared for the WNBA draft, claiming they identify as women. League sources told FOS on Monday that the two former NBA players are not eligible based on the league’s current eligibility rules. No trans players born male at birth have played in the WNBA’s 30-year history. Freedom attended the Sky’s game Sunday in Chicago against the Indiana Fever and sat courtside by the baseline. He was removed from the arena late in the third quarter after he and Cloud exchanged words. Cloud said she believes the culture war surrounding the WNBA is an “intentional distraction.” “The more that we hate each other, the more that we have bias against each other, the more we’re going to be distracted from real life issues that are plaguing our communities,” Cloud said. She also suggested that the league is being used as a platform for conservatives with the midterm elections coming up later this year. “We are a microcosm of a bigger issue that is our society. And we wouldn’t allow our league to be used as a pawn for any political or cultural wars that the right side wants. We’re absolutely not going to,” Cloud said. Cloud pointed the finger at men, saying they are the main demographic attacking the WNBA and trans community. “The men now who are like, ‘Oh we need to protect the WNBA.’ Ya’ll are the same ones who are saying we shouldn’t have been paid,” she said. “Ya’ll were the same ones saying that we shouldn’t have been invested into. Ya’ll are the same ones saying that we’re a joke. … If you’re going to protect women, that includes all women. That includes black women, trans women, and the list goes on and on and on. So that root of the issue is? Men.” She clarified after: “And we love ya’ll men that stand with standards cause there is a standard.” WNBA Ban? Cloud commended the Sky organization for banning Freedom from the team’s home games following the incident, and she wants the WNBA to do the same across all WNBA games. On Monday, Sky owner Michael Alter spoke to Chicago-based reporters, including Front Office Sports , in a rare press conference and announced Freedom’s ban . He also showed his support for the decision of security and Chicago police to remove Freedom from the arena, saying Freedom “turned himself into a threat” after he stepped toward the baseline from his courtside seat. “Michael goes and bans and that’s immediate action,” Cloud said Saturday ahead of the team’s game against the New York Liberty. We’re asking for protection and that’s what protection looks like from a man. That’s what protection looks like from men.” She added: “I hope the WNBA follows their lead as well.” But the WNBA has no plan of issuing a league-wide ban for Freedom, a league source told FOS on Monday. The WNBA did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The post Natasha Cloud Calls WNBA Culture War an ‘Intentional Distraction’ appeared first on Front Office Sports .

Pics matching an area are grouped in a cluster and once you ope
articles._body: As soon as Ubimage has the correct permissions it starts showing your pictures and videos on the horizon (provided you have any in your current location). If you have many you can filter by distance, altitude, years or favorites. Pics matching an area are grouped in a cluster and once you open it you have a carousel to select from. You can filter pics from a cluster by showing only those that point in a certain direction. This is because pics usually also store the direction the camera was facing. Once you select a picture you can see its statistics relative to you, copy coordinates, share it and open in the Maps app. I've been building Ubimage on and off for a while, at the beginning I just wanted an app to help me find again spots I've already rode with my enduro bike, the idea was simple, read the gps and draw the thumbnails of the pics from Photos app on the screen, sort of augmented reality. I even gave it a nice name, Panoramixer, then I thought that I didn't want to fight Obelix's lawyer but I digress. After one year I started working on it again and when I finally found how to pin thumbs to the horizon I decided that Ubimage maybe could be published. It's a free app no ads, no IAP, no account and no analytics, if you're paranoid you can use it offline. I'm not planning on becoming millionaire with it, I just want to share it with like minded people. you can download it from the App Store the link is on the support site: https://ubimage.app I will not make an Android version, but maybe I could share ideas with someone willing to clone Ubimage. I'd like to know what you think about this app and if pictures land correctly on your part of the world. articles.title: Rutgers Football Top 10 Countdown: Tyler Needham
articles.summary: The Knight Report counts down the days until Rutgers Football kicks off by breaking down the Top 10 Players for the Scarlet Knights in 2026.
articles._body: The Knight Report counts down the days until kickoff by breaking down the Top 10 Players for Rutgers Football in 2026, revealing one each day until the start of the season. Veteran offensive tackle Tyler Needham becomes the second entry along the offensive line, coming in at No. 6 overall. For a limited time, new members get their first year of exclusive Scarlet Knights coverage for just $30 – that’s 75% off. Don’t miss the sale of the season. Tyler Needham’s Profile Playing both right and left tackle in his two seasons starting, this next player on the list has now solidified himself at one of the most important positions in football. Needham returns to Rutgers for his sixth season with the program. The Philadelphia, Pennsylvania native was the 918th overall prospect coming out of William Penn Charter in 2021. The offensive lineman would make his first appearance as a true freshman in the Gator Bowl against Wake Forest. Needham would see action in three games as sophomore. He would get his first opportunity as a starter at right tackle entering his junior season. Unfortunately his 2023 season came to a premature end as he would sustain an injury against Temple in the second game. Needham would return from his injury in 2024, slotting in at right tackle once again. He started the first eight games of the season before injuries limited his usage down the stretch. Returning from injury for the second consecutive season had Needham in a position battle for one of the tackle positions in 2025. Taj White stepped up at right tackle, while Dantae Chin would surprisingly win out at left tackle, leaving him as a reserve. An injury sustained to Chin in the second game of the season required Needham to become the full-time starter at left tackle. New offensive line coach Jim Turner arrived in the offseason, and Chin slid back to the interior offensive line. While much has changed around him, especially in his six seasons with the Scarlet Knights, Needham’s experience should help anchor him at one of the most crucial positions in the sport. Run Blocking The veteran has become an exceptional run blocker over his past two seasons, helping to produce two of the best running back seasons in school history. He graded out as the 20th and 28th best run blocking tackle nationally in 2024 and 2025, respectively. When running off right tackle and the edge in 2024, the Rutgers backfield totaled 598 yards and seven scores on 5.4 yards per attempt. Looking at those same numbers but to the left side, the backs racked up 392 yards on four yards per carry and seven touchdowns in 2025. Needham will be paired with either Kobe Asamoah or Dantae Chin at the guard spot this season, and looks to replicate similar levels of success that he has seen alongside Bryan Felter and Asamoah, previously. Pass Protection Pass blocking has been an area of inconsistency for Needham over his past two seasons at both left and right tackle. He allowed just one pressure over the three out of conference matchups last season. The first Big Ten game against Iowa would be wake up call for Needham working on a new side of the offensive line. He allowed five pressures and a sack in his first conference start at left tackle. His play in pass protection would steady up in the last quarter of the season, as he allowed just two pressures and one sack in the final three games. In 2025, Needham allowed 18 pressures and five sacks in 415 pass blocking snaps. Although it is not entirely the same skillset at either tackle spot, it is worth noting that he allowed 21 pressures and two sacks in 330 passing downs on the right side in 2024. His experience playing both tackle spots and inline tight end provides important insurance if injuries were to force the frontlines to shake up at any point in the season. articles.title: Pirates’ latest Konnor Griffin injury update is crucial
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a number of intriguing additions leading into the 2026 season and stayed relatively busy at the trade deadline (or at least busier than usual), doing what they reasonably could to improve the team’s competitive outlook in the present. But their most importa
articles._body: The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a number of intriguing additions leading into the 2026 season and stayed relatively busy at the trade deadline (or at least busier than usual), doing what they reasonably could to improve the team’s competitive outlook in the present. But their most important decision concerned the long-term future of the franchise. Owner Bob Nutting made a historic commitment to top prospect Konnor Griffin in April, and fans have loved what they’ve seen in the ensuing months. They just want more of it. Well, following a summer rife with disappointment, the city may actually receive some good news . Griffin is scheduled to begin a rehab assignment on Sunday in Double-A Altoona and will be eligible to return from the injured list on Friday, per beat reporter Alex Stumpf. The 20-year-old shortstop has missed nearly two months of action with a torn sagittal band in his left ring finger , which came shortly after he missed nearly a month due to a flexor strain in his right forearm. The Pirates (65-71) are seven and a half games out of the final National League Wild Card slot. Neither the club nor their fans will experience October ecstasy this year, but a healthy and effective Griffin can still provide a source of hope. The Pirates have chosen Konnor Griffin to lead them out of darkness The definition of “going all in” changes wildly throughout the MLB landscape. When the Los Angeles Dodgers use the phrase, they are communicating in a completely different language from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The league and MLB Players Association will have far too much time to debate the reasons for this gargantuan gap, but the Buccos did extend past their normal boundaries quite a bit in the last year. They acquired veterans Brandon Lowe, Ryan O’Hearn and Marcell Ozuna — who has since been released — to jump-start the offense, and they brought in a quartet of relief pitchers at the beginning of August to remedy the pitching woes. Those moves will not be enough to end Pittsburgh’s NL-worst 10-year postseason drought, but they showed initiative. Konnor Griffin is the embodiment of the Pirates’ more proactive approach. Pittsburgh signed the Mississippi native to a franchise-record $140 million contract extension, which will make him an organizational pillar through 2034. Several years after 2025 NL Cy Young Award winner Paul Skenes hits free agency, Griffin will still be representing the Buccos. Ideally, he will be an established superstar long by then, but that transformation can only progress when he is off the IL. The No. 9 overall pick in the 2024 MLB Draft is batting .276 with five home runs, 25 RBIs, 20 stolen bases, a .332 on-base percentage, .404 slugging percentage and .736 OPS through 247 plate appearances. This prodigy should resume his pursuit of greatness in the near future. The post Pirates’ latest Konnor Griffin injury update is crucial appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Sparks sign ex-Valkyries guard to final roster spot
articles.summary: After the Los Angeles Sparks converted rookie guard Tonie Morgan’s contract to a standard deal, they had one open roster spot in the form of one of the league’s new developmental contracts. With only five games remaining in the regular season, the Sparks signed former Texas and Vanderbilt guard N
articles._body: After the Los Angeles Sparks converted rookie guard Tonie Morgan’s contract to a standard deal , they had one open roster spot in the form of one of the league’s new developmental contracts. With only five games remaining in the regular season, the Sparks signed former Texas and Vanderbilt guard Ndjakalenga Mwenentanda to that open roster spot. As per the new CBA, WNBA teams were essentially given two additional roster spots aside from the standard 12 to fill as developmental contracts. Those players are limited to being active for only 12 games each while not being eligible to play in the playoffs unless their deal is converted to a standard contract. However, teams are only permitted to use players on developmental contracts for up to 24 games regardless of how many games said player has appeared in. The Sparks have already rotated multiple players on developmental deals this season including Morgan, Kate Martin, Laura Ziegler, Alissa Pili and now Ndjakalenga Mwenentanda. In total, the Sparks have used 19 of those 24 games between the aforementioned players, leaving five games in which Mwenentanda can appear in to close the season. After going undrafted in the 2026 WNBA Draft, Mwenentanda caught on with the Golden State Valkyries for training camp. She was waived before the start of the season, but later brought back on a replacement contract after Iliana Rupert stepped away from the team due to childbirth. She appeared in five games with the Valkyries at a little over two minutes per game. She grabbed two rebounds and dished out two assists in that time while taking only one shot. The Sparks have already been eliminated from playoff contention , and head coach Lynne Roberts recently acknowledged that the team’s front office wanted to see more of the bench and younger players receive playing time as the regular season winds down. The team has one more game left, on the road against the Seattle Storm on Sunday, before the WNBA goes on an approximately three-week break for the FIBA World Cup. Mwenentanda will presumably be with the team in time for that game, but it’s as of yet unclear if she will be active. articles._body: The Boston Red Sox remain uncertain about the return dates for Roman Anthony and Trevor Story. Both players are continuing their rehab assignments with Triple-A Worcester. Red Sox beat writer Tim Healey of The Boston Globe said there was no major update on either player’s status as of Saturday morning. Worcester’s 4 p.m. game on Saturday will feature Anthony and Story in the lineup. After the game, the Red Sox will decide on their next steps. The Red Sox haven’t ruled out bringing one or both players back to the major league roster on Sunday. Interim manager Chad Tracy said the team is still undecided. “It’s just hard to say right now,” Tracy said, according to Healey. Anthony and Story have both been working to return as the Red Sox enter a key part of their season. Anthony has missed games since May due to a finger injury. Story has been rehabbing from his own injury. If Anthony returns, he could give Boston another strong offensive option after his impressive rookie season. Story would add veteran experience and provide more defensive flexibility to the lineup. Their presence could energize both the team and the fans. For now, the Red Sox seem content to let both players continue their rehab in Worcester. Saturday’s game will give the team another chance to assess if either player is ready to return on Sunday. With both players possibly close to returning, Red Sox fans will have to wait a bit longer to learn exactly when Anthony and Story will rejoin the major league team. articles._body: Running back Corey Kiner got the scoring started in the new football year , punching in a one-yard inside run early in the second quarter of the Hall of Fame Game between the Arizona Cardinals and Carolina Panthers. The opening score of the 2026 NFL exhibition slate provided an early glimpse of Kiner’s physical, downhill running style. With final roster cutdowns looming across the league, the New England Patriots made an aggressive move to bolster their running back depth by acquiring Kiner in a trade with Arizona. Sending a future conditional pick allows the Patriots to bring in an ascending, low-cost rusher with live-game production before he hits the open waiver wire. For Kiner, heading to New England provides a clear pathway to compete for rotational touches in a physical offensive scheme as the regular season approaches. articles.title: The U.S. doesn’t have a state-owned oil giant. But in Venezuela, the federal government will control a company with the world’s 2nd largest reserves
articles.summary: The federal government will control 55% of the company's effective output via equity ownership and oil production.
articles._body: Many of the world’s top oil countries have state-run national champions, such as Saudi Arabia’s Aramco, Russia’s Rosneft, the UAE’s Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, Brazil’s Petrobras , and Mexico’s Pemex . But the U.S., which is the world’s biggest oil producer, doesn’t have one, leaving the task of pumping crude to private-sector giants like Exxon Mobil and Chevron as well as the multitude of wildcatters across the Permian Basin. The Trump administration’s deal for 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves , however, will give the federal government a stake in a new joint venture. The country’s interim president, Delcy Rodriguez, has granted a private company a 100-year lease for prime oil fields, a U.S. official said, according to reports . The federal government will control 55% of the company’s effective output via equity ownership and oil production. A private Venezuelan operator will have the remaining share. The U.S. official said the company will be the world’s second-largest corporate holder of proven reserves after Saudi Aramco . For her part, Rodriguez said the deal will bring in more than $100 billion of investment and generate $209 billion for Venezuela’s government. Venezuela has the largest oil reserves in the world, with an estimated 303 billion barrels. President Donald Trump’s deal to gain control of 65 billion barrels of that amount exceeds the U.S. proven reserve total of 46 billion. The Trump administration’s majority stake in an oil company follows its investments in chipmaker Intel , rare earths miner MP Materials, mineral explorer Trilogy Metals, and dozens of other firms . It also has revenue-sharing agreements with AI chip leaders Nvidia and AMD for sales to China. The latest deal comes nearly nine months after Trump ordered the military to capture Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro and bring him to the U.S. to face federal narcoterrorism and drug trafficking charges. A month after that operation, the U.S. and Israel launched a war against Iran that resulted in the worst-ever energy supply shock in history, spiking prices higher and forcing countries to draw down crude stockpiles. In the U.S., the Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen to 289.7 million barrels, its lowest level since November 1982. Some industry experts have warned that the SPR will soon reach operational minimums soon, wiping out any further cushion to offset the oil deficit from the Middle East. The U.S. official told reporters that as the U.S.-Venezuelan company ramps up oil production, its output will help restock the SPR. But Venezuela’s oil sector has been in disrepair for decades, and production is now only 1.1 million barrels a day, down from a peak of 3.5 million barrels more than 20 years ago. Boosting the country’s output to those levels again would require billions of dollars in investment and years before they reach fruition. Meanwhile, global oil giants with the financial resources to make such investments must be convinced that it’s safe to do business in Venezuela again after their assets were nationalized by earlier governments. Some are preparing the make the leap. Chevron is close to a deal to expand its longstanding operations in Venezuela, sources told the Wall Street Journal . Oilfield-services giant Halliburton is also in talks to bring equipment to the country, and executives from several oil-and-gas companies will sign production deals next week, the report added. Italy’s Eni, which has a presence in Venezuela, announced Saturday that it’s working with authorities there to help revitalize the energy sector. Still, many details about Trump’s new Venezuela venture are still unknown, and energy experts were skeptical about how much investment it could bring. “For sure, and if Venezuela ever gets anything resembling a democratic government, the very first thing it will do is flush Trump’s deal down the toilet,” Dean Baker, senior economist at the Center for Economic and Policy Research, posted on X . This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Nashville Airport to Be Renamed for Dolly Parton, Tennessee Governor Announces
articles.summary: The news comes just days after the iconic singer’s passing.
articles._body: Tennessee is honoring Dolly Parton in a major way following the country music icon’s death. On Friday (Aug. 28), Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee and Nashville International Airport (BNA) announced plans to rename the travel hub in Parton’s honor following her death earlier this week. Related Change.Org Petition To Rename Nashville Airport in Honor of Dolly Parton Gains Massive Support: ‘Dolly Deserves to Be Remembered and Celebrated’ Dolly Parton’s 25 Best Songs: Critics’ Picks Dolly Parton Wasn’t Eligible for Song of the Year Grammy for ‘I Will Always Love You’ for This ‘Unforgettable’ Reason “Dolly Parton’s extraordinary life is forever woven into the fabric of our state,” Lee said in a statement. “At a place where Tennessee welcomes the world, it is fitting that Nashville International Airport would bear the name of our state’s favorite daughter and greet travelers with the enduring legacy of Dolly’s music, generosity, faith, and kindness.” The announcement comes just days after the Queen of Country died on Aug. 25 following a “brief battle with cancer,” according to her team. Parton’s team “expressed their appreciation for the extraordinary outpouring of support to honor Dolly,” Lee wrote, adding that they are “touched by the idea and open to continuing the conversation.” Nashville Mayor Freddie O’Connell also voiced his support for renaming the airport in a statement shared on Instagram . “Dolly was in the process of working with us on a remarkable hotel and museum — SongTeller — that she called her love letter to Nashville,” O’Connell wrote. “Now it’s our turn to share a love letter to Dolly — by renaming Nashville International Airport to Dolly Parton International Airport in Nashville.” The Metro Nashville Airport Authority’s (MNAA) current naming policy, along with Lee’s proposal to rename Nashville International Airport, will be discussed at a meeting scheduled for Sept. 17. Additional details are expected to be announced in the coming weeks, according to the governor’s statement. “BNA is the front door to Music City, and with that comes a responsibility to reflect the very best of who we are as a community,” MNAA president and CEO Doug Kreulen said. Earlier this week, a Change.org petition calling for Nashville International Airport to be renamed Dolly Parton International Airport in honor of the singer-songwriter gained significant support. As of Saturday morning (Aug. 29), the petition had collected more than 164,000 signatures.

articles.summary: As the playoffs draw near for the Los Angeles Dodgers, with the team waiting on the pitching return of Shohei Ohtani, other players on the team look to come back and play to their high standards. With Dodgers closer Edwin Díaz still out, along with catcher Dalton Rushing, the two get key injury u
articles._body: As the playoffs draw near for the Los Angeles Dodgers , with the team waiting on the pitching return of Shohei Ohtani, other players on the team look to come back and play to their high standards. With Dodgers closer Edwin Díaz still out , along with catcher Dalton Rushing, the two get key injury updates. Starting with Díaz, who has been dealing with inflammation on the right side of his neck, he is “working through a bullpen progression,” and the next step will be a rehab assignment before coming back to the team, via MLB.com. As an expected return is mid-September, the same month could also see Rushing come back, who has “started a throwing progression,: though his “ability to catch again this season is still in question.” If you ask Rushing himself, not only does he feel he is “progressing well,” but he plans to be catching in September, looking to help his team. “I’m progressing well. I feel good,” Rushing said, according to DodgersBeat.com. “We are starting [a] throwing progression very soon. So, the plan is for me to be on the field in September.” Dodgers’ Edwin Diaz likely not in same role upon return So far this season, Rushing has recorded a .253 batting average with 12 home runs and 36 RBIs in 74 games, whereas Díaz’s season has been frustrating, to say the least. Recording a 11.85 ERA with 19 strikeouts and seven saves in 16 games, it’s likely that he won’t be the closer when returning from his second stint on the injured list, as Díaz understands he hasn’t “done my job.” “I’m good with the decision because I know I haven’t done my job,” Díaz said, via MLB.com. “If I’d done my job, I’d be pitching in the ninth inning. But I’m super happy because Tanner Scott is doing his job and doing it really well.” “It’s a little bit frustrating because I know the pitcher I am,” Díaz said. “I know when I’m good, I can do really good things. I’m working to come back in that form.” It remains to be seen how Díaz and Rushing progress for the Dodgers. articles.title: JOL’s Countdown to Kickoff: No. 5
articles.summary: JOL continues its countdown to kickoff vs. Colorado on Sept. 3 with a look at historical Jacket Justin Thomas and current Jacket Zachary Tobe.
articles._body: The countdown is on until “Toe Meets Leather” on Sept. 3 when Georgia Tech hosts Colorado in the 2026 season opener on The Flats. Over the next several days JOL will look at at least one current Jacket and/or a historical Jacket of the corresponding number to the days until kickoff, continuing today with No. 5. Historical Jacket: Justin Thomas Justin Thomas was an option quarterback that ran Paul Johnson’s offensive attack well over three years as the starter, throwing for 40 touchdowns and rushing for another 22 while racking up two wins over rival Georgia along with bowl wins over Mississippi State (Orange Bowl) and Kentucky (TaxSlayer Bowl). Thomas was a highly-rated prospect as an athlete during his prep days while playing at Prattville High (Ala.) and led his team to a state championship as a senior in 2011 at quarterback. He originally committed to Alabama but eventually flipped to Georgia Tech in the 2012 recruiting class, as the Jackets offered him the chance to play quarterback rather than defensive back where the Crimson Tide had him slotted into their recruiting class. Thomas redshirted his first season on The Flats in 2012 and then played in 10 games as a redshirt-freshman in 2013, mostly as a backup as he threw for a touchdown and ran for two touchdowns over limited reps in 10 games. Following the transfer of previous starter Vad Lee, Thomas took over as the full-time starter in 2014 and had a huge year, starting all 14 games and throwing for 1,719 yards and 18 touchdowns while rushing for another 1,086 yards and eight touchdowns. He was named All-ACC Second Team by the league’s coaches and Phil Steele and All-ACC Third Team by the ACSMA while helping Tech to an 11-3 record, a win over rival Georgia in Athens and an Orange Bowl victory over Mississippi State. He was named Orange Bowl MVP after throwing and running for 100-plus yards, rushing for three TDs and throwing for another. Thomas still produced strong numbers during his redshirt-junior season despite Tech’s struggles as a team overall in 2015 as the team went 3-9. He threw for 1,345 yards and 13 touchdowns and rushed for 488 yards and six touchdowns. Thomas and the Jackets bounced back in 2016 with a 9-4 campaign that included another win over rival Georgia in Athens and a TaxSlayer Bowl victory over Kentucky. He finished his college career strong with 1,559 passing yards and eight touchdowns along with another 604 yards on the ground and six touchdowns. Thomas finished his Tech career in the top 10 in career passing yards (seventh, 4,754), career passing touchowns (sixth, 40), career rushing yards (ninth, 2,412) and career rushing touchdowns (tied-10th, 22). He is also fourth all-time in Tech history in total offensive yards with 7,166, fifth in single-season total offensive yards with 2,805 in 2014 and third in single-game offensive yards with 459 vs. Duke in 2016. Thomas had a brief run in the NFL after signing with the New Orleans Saints as an undrafted free agent in 2016 and then being a part of the Los Angeles Rams and Pittsburgh Steelers’ franchises over the next two seasons but never made it onto the active roster. Thomas later played for the Atlanta Legends of the Alliance of American Football in 2019, was signed briefly by the Hamilton Tiger-Cats of the Canadian Football League in 2019 and then drafted by the DC Defenders in the 2020 XFL Draft before being released leading up to the season. Georgia Tech’s Zachary Tobe goes through a drill at a recent fall camp practice. (Photo by Kelly Quinlan/JOL) Current Jackets: Zachary Tobe Wearing the No. 5 this season for the Jackets is senior cornerback Zachary Tobe . Tobe has been with the GT program for the last two seasons after starting his college career at Illinois. He played in all 13 games last fall with 12 of those being starts as he compiled 30 total tackles (17 solo), two pass breakups and one fumble recovery. In his first year on The Flats in 2024 as a sophomore, Tobe played in 12 games and had 17 tackles (14 solo), two tackles-for-loss and three pass breakups. In his one season at Illinois as a freshman in 2023, he saw action in 10 games with three starts and had 25 tackles and five pass breakups. Tobe, who was a 3-star prospect according to Rivals in the 2023 class out of Ocoee High (Fla.), is majoring in history, technology and society at Georgia Tech.

articles.title: Mets’ Juan Soto officially returning from injury vs. Astros
articles.summary: Reports on Friday indicated that Juan Soto was going to return from his calf injury relatively soon, as the superstar slugger claimed he thought he might skip a rehab assignment. On Saturday, leading up to the game against the Houston Astros, the New York Mets finally announced his return to the
articles._body: Reports on Friday indicated that Juan Soto was going to return from his calf injury relatively soon, as the superstar slugger claimed he thought he might skip a rehab assignment. On Saturday, leading up to the game against the Houston Astros, the New York Mets finally announced his return to the majors. The 27-year-old outfielder was officially reinstated from the 10-day IL and will be active for the contest against Houston. Infielder Eric Wagaman was optioned to Triple-A Syracuse to make room on New York’s 26-man roster. “We have made the following roster moves,” the Mets announced on X. “OF Juan Soto has been reinstated from the 10-day Injured List. INF Eric Wagaman was optioned to Triple-A Syracuse following last night’s game.” Soto will bat second in the lineup in his first game back from injury. He’ll step in as the designated hitter. Brett Baty, AJ Ewing, and Carson Benge will play in the outfield against the Astros. It’s been an injury-riddled campaign for the nine-year veteran. The game against the Astros will be just Soto’s 85th of the season. The Mets are hopeful he’ll return and improve the offensive production immediately, as Soto’s been as good as ever when healthy this year. Through 293 at-bats entering Saturday’s contest, Juan Soto has recorded 83 hits, 21 home runs, and 52 RBIs. He owns a solid .283 batting average and .408 OBP. While the Mets are on the outside looking in on the playoff race, the club will be glad to have Soto’s bat in the lineup for the final few weeks of the regular season. Giants shortstop Willy Adames gets key injury update after UCL sprain
articles.summary: The latest update on Willy Adames leaves the San Francisco Giants with only a narrow path for their shortstop to play again this season. Any return depends on how his left elbow responds over the next month. Team doctors diagnosed Adames with a moderate sprain of the ulnar collateral ligament (UC
articles._body: The latest update on Willy Adames leaves the San Francisco Giants with only a narrow path for their shortstop to play again this season. Any return depends on how his left elbow responds over the next month. Team doctors diagnosed Adames with a moderate sprain of the ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) in his non-throwing arm. Dr. Keith Meister confirmed that diagnosis and did not recommend surgery. Adames received a platelet-rich plasma injection Thursday. The projected recovery is three to four weeks. Adames remains on the 10-day injured list. The Giants’ regular season ends on September 27, which leaves only a small window in the final week. The San Francisco Chronicle’s Susan Slusser published Adames’ latest comments Friday after speaking with him . “I’m hoping that I can play in the last week—I don’t know how many days we’re going to have,” Adames said. “But if I’m not 100%, I don’t think I’m going to push it. It would be different if we were in a different position, but even though I want to be out there every day, I have to feel 100%.” Adames injured the elbow last Sunday at Fenway Park while sliding home against the Boston Red Sox. Connor Wong’s knee hit his left arm. Adames said he felt the pain during the slide. The Giants placed him on the injured list Monday. Meister’s second opinion confirmed the UCL sprain. Thursday’s injection started a short shutdown before rehabilitation could advance. Manager Tony Vitello said a return in the final week would be the best possible outcome. Neither Vitello nor the medical staff has cleared Adames for baseball activity or set a return date. San Francisco enters Saturday afternoon at 55-80, which reduces the incentive for Adames to risk a setback for a brief late-season appearance. Whether he plays again in 2026 will depend on the elbow and whether he feels fully healthy before the schedule ends. articles.title: Yankees’ Aaron Boone makes Elmer Rodriguez announcement during Red Sox series
articles.summary: The New York Yankees hope to hold off the Boston Red Sox in the American League East division standings this weekend. Yankees manager Aaron Boone is making a big announcement, as that series continues. Boone is keeping Elmer Rodriguez on the team’s starting rotation. “Elmer Rodriguez
articles._body: The New York Yankees hope to hold off the Boston Red Sox in the American League East division standings this weekend. Yankees manager Aaron Boone is making a big announcement, as that series continues. Boone is keeping Elmer Rodriguez on the team’s starting rotation . “Elmer Rodriguez will stick in the rotation for at least one more turn to start Monday against the Angels, Aaron Boone said,” ESPN reported on X, formerly Twitter. This season, Rodriguez has a 4.70 ERA in five starts. He has struggled this season, as the pitcher hasn’t posted a win. He also has a 1.52 WHIP. Rodriguez is coming off a strong start, though, which is likely the reason he is sticking around. The Yankees pitcher allowed just three hits over six innings of work, in a New York win over the Houston Astros. “It was just trusting myself,” Rodríguez said, per MLB.com. “It’s something that I’ve been building up since my first couple of starts, and so each time I’ve felt better. I’ve been working on some stuff down there [in the Minors], and I feel like it’s been working so far.” New York’s coaches have trust in Rodriguez. They are looking for him to improve moving forward. “It seems like when he has struggled up here,” Yankees pitching coach Matt Blake said, “he’s just kind of flirting with the strike zone more than living in it. For him to be successful at this level, it’s not giving the hitters too much credit.” The Yankees are hoping to get their rotation fully healthy, as the season starts to wind down. New York is currently second in the AL East, with a 76-58 record. The Yankees host a doubleheader against the Red Sox on Saturday. New York has seven wins in their last 10 games. articles.title: How did Georgia navigate heat and prep for nine-game SEC slate?
articles.summary: It was hot in Athens throughout Georgia’s fall camp. Camp is done. Georgia has the heftiest SEC schedule the program has ever faced awaiting it once the season gets rolling. Head coach Kirby Smart and his staff took all of that into account when designing the layout of fall camp. The schedule
articles._body: It was hot in Athens throughout Georgia’s fall camp. Camp is done. Georgia has the heftiest SEC schedule the program has ever faced awaiting it once the season gets rolling. Head coach Kirby Smart and his staff took all of that into account when designing the layout of fall camp. The schedule itself took a bit of a shift. Week zero kicks off this week. There was an opportunity on the table for there to be fewer practices in the summer to accommodate that week of games. The coaches of college football voted to start later. That came with mandated days off. Georgia went with a ‘three on, one off’ model for this year’s fall camp. The typical fall camp featured five or six days in a row of practices. The Bulldogs wanted to get a lot of work in while also allowing time to recover from the physical practices and Georgia heat the team had to endure this summer. “The NCAA gave us a different format, and they’re changing it again next year; there are less days in camp and less practices in the lead-up,” Smart told the Steakhouse on Friday. “We as coaches voted to not start earlier because they started week zero. In anticipation of that and a little bit of change this year, we had a format of three on, one off, and three on, one off. Instead of in years past, we’d go five or six days in a row and take one off.” The layout made for a ‘mini camp’ like atmosphere for the Bulldogs throughout camp. “It was a little more mini campish, because you get the day in between for recovery and there were some lighter, shorter practices in there really due to the heat,” Smart said. “We looked hard at the temperatures we practiced in last year, and it was seven or eight degrees difference in the heat we practiced in last year to this year. We’re just trying to be smart and cognizant of the nine-game part of it and how long the season is going to be.” How does the opponent shape fall camp for Georgia? The shift did not take out the intensity of camp. It was still hard. The typical dog days of fall camp were still something that Georgia had to navigate. Georgia will hit the field with a different color jersey on the other sideline for the first time since January next weekend. The Bulldogs will host Tennessee State at Sanford Stadium on Saturday. The Bulldogs will be a heavy favorite not just in week one but in week two as well. “Camp is camp,” Smart said. “I don’t philosophically change camp unless the NCAA makes us or we want to have nine SEC games. We’re not going to change it based on who we play. Now, the week of the first game and when you start on the opponent, sure, we’ll change things based on who that matchup is. I’m more able to try new things and experiment with traditions and the rituals that we have for a lead-up to a game.” Smart is always looking, even in-season, to experiment when the schedule allows to find new ways of doing things in game preparation. “For us, we try different things in practice,” Smart said. “We give twos more reps, threes more reps based on who we play and where we are in the season. With it being with the openers we have, we have the luxury of being able to experiment. We may experiment with a different practice format on a Tuesday or Wednesday in season. Maybe we do less on a Thursday or more on a Friday. I’m always open to hearing how other people do things to find a better way.”

articles.title: Red Sox’s Chad Tracy reveals Roman Anthony’s role once he returns from injury
articles.summary: As the Boston Red Sox are currently in a series with the New York Yankees, the team faces some interesting decisions about the return of key players soon. While the Red Sox expect Roman Anthony to return from injury, interim manager Chad Tracy has spoken about the 22-year-old’s role when he
articles._body: As the Boston Red Sox are currently in a series with the New York Yankees , the team faces some interesting decisions about the return of key players soon. While the Red Sox expect Roman Anthony to return from injury, interim manager Chad Tracy has spoken about the 22-year-old’s role when he comes back. According to Ian Browne of MLB.com, Boston is willing to use Anthony in the lead-off spot against right-handed pitchers when he returns. As for left-handed pitchers, that’s labeled as “TBD,” as the team uses Jahmai Jones for that aspect. “Chad Tracy said he is leaning towards Roman Anthony leading off against righties as soon as he comes back. TBD against lefties the way Jahmai Jones is going,” Browne wrote on X, formerly Twitter. Anthony hasn’t played for the club since May 4 as he dealt with a “partially torn tendon in right ring finger,” via MLB.com, as he’s only recorded a .229 batting average to go along with one home run and five RBIs in 30 games and 109 at-bats. More on the injury return of Red Sox’s Roman Anthony The Red Sox’s outfielder in Anthony, along with Trevor Story, are currently with Triple-A Worcester on rehab assignments. With them playing on Saturday for the minor league team, the earliest the two could be activated is Sunday vs. the Yankees, per MLB.com. “Like we’ve been doing, we’ll check in with them [Saturday] after playing and see where they’re at physically and how they feel after that and re-assess,” said Tracy. “I think a lot of people have the perception that maybe we circled a date on the calendar. But when you’re out for three and a half months, it’s difficult to circle a date on the calendar. “It’s more about just continuing to walk through not only physically how they feel, but walk through like reps, timing all those things. So we’ll keep talking to them and figure it out. Sunday’s possible, but we’ll see how they feel after Saturday.” It remains to be seen if Anthony will make his return on Sunday, but either way, it appears to be imminent. articles.title: Carson Hocevar is NASCAR’s online merchandise king, but calls for Kyle Busch to take fan crown
articles.summary: Carson Hocevar reacts to leading NASCAR online merchandise sales but says Kyle Busch deserves to win Most Popular Driver this season.
articles._body: Carson Hocevar continues to move the needle. He was all over the place last weekend at New Hampshire to ultimately finish P19. A few days later, NASCAR announced that the Spire star is leading online merchandise sales and is in the top five at on-track merchandise sales. He also received a stamp of approval from 7-time NASCAR Cup Series Champ Jimmie Johnson on Friday night, seemingly out of nowhere.   On Friday, Hocevar was asked if he was surprised by the merchandise sales.  An appreciative Hocevar admitted he was shocked by the sales statistics.  ‘I was a little shocked’ The online sales shocked Hocevar, but not as much as the at-track sales.  And that number is surprising, not because of a lack of Hocevar fans at the track; it’s because he shares a merchandise trailer with as many as five drivers from up to three different race teams.    “I was a little shocked,” said Hocevar. “You know, I was appreciative of it, for sure. But yeah, I was a little shocked.  “I would say I’m more shocked that I’m in the top five for at track because, you know, we don’t have my own merch trailer or anything, and there’s limited options there “They do a good job selling and pushing them out. “But I was more shocked by that, honestly. Maybe there’ll be more options, and if anything for me, I feel like we’re just kind of getting started. “So hopefully that trend can continue. I’m just appreciative of that. That means a lot to me.” Hocevar backs Kyle Busch for NASCAR Most Popular Driver  Chase Elliott has won the NASCAR Most Popular Driver Award every year since 2018.  He had mentioned previously about removing his name from the ballot in hopes that his voters would choose Kyle Busch, who he felt deserved it this year.  On Friday, Hocevar was asked about the possibility of winning the award, considering the surge in merchandise sales this season. Hocevar quickly said this year, the award should go to Busch.  “I mean, possible. Possible for sure. But I feel like if anybody should get it this year, I think it should be Kyle. “So, you know, maybe I’ll wait for next year.” New year, new Hocevar Hocevar had a growing fanbase last year. It skyrocketed this season.  Hocevar was asked if it feels different returning to Daytona this week, compared to the same time last year.  “It does. I don’t know what aspects feel that much different. It just all feels different, which I’ve enjoyed, and it’s been fun. “You get to walk a little taller, which I’m already tall, but you get to walk a little bit firmer with how we’ve run this year. But, you know, just everything that we have clicking for us right now.  And I think we all do that as a company, too, because I think we’re really early in this plan they have developed for our race team and how fast we can go. “So I’m confident in the trajectory. We get to walk a little bit prouder, knowing that we’re pretty fast right now, but tomorrow and the next day after that and every day after that, hopefully we just continue to get a little bit better every time.” “Yeah, I’ve always tried to want to enjoy it because it’s been a dream of mine to do it.  I’ve watched other drivers do podcasts or interviews or whatever and talk about how much they just were miserable the whole time.  “I was like, that doesn’t sound very fun. So I just try not to have that happen when, hopefully, I’m 20, 30 years around later telling those stories.”

articles.title: What Edmundo Sosa said about clutch 9th inning grand slam vs. Angels
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies need every win they can get. As a result, they are salivating over a big 5-3 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday. The catalyst was when left fielder Edmundo Sosa hit a 9th-inning grand slam. After the game, Sosa spoke of the moment, per Paul Casella of MLB.com. Sos
articles._body: The Philadelphia Phillies need every win they can get . As a result, they are salivating over a big 5-3 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday. The catalyst was when left fielder Edmundo Sosa hit a 9th-inning grand slam. After the game, Sosa spoke of the moment , per Paul Casella of MLB.com. Sosa set the stage for what was about to happen. At first, second baseman Bryson Stott could have been the hero in the 9th inning. It looks as though he was going to hit the three-run homer, but Angels right fielder Wade Meckler made a spectacular catch. Thus, Sosa took it upon himself to step up to the plate even when the momentum shifted in that direction. “Stott gets robbed on that tremendous play — a big league play — and the energy went on their side at that moment,” Sosa said via interpreter Diego D’Aniello. “The whole stadium was euphoric. But I think I just stayed calm and focused, and I parked myself next to Don right after that, and just trusted that maybe the opportunity was coming for me.” Then, Sosa delivered in a big way. The Phillies are now 75-60 and are trailing the Atlanta Braves by five games in the National League East. Meanwhile, the Phillies are in a fiercely tight battle with the Chicago Cubs for the National League Wild Card. Sosa is batting .235 with 46 hits, 6 home runs, and 39 RBIs. The series against the Angels runs into Sunday. After that, Philadelphia will head to Arizona to play the Diamondbacks in a three-game series. Tigers’ Riley Greene set for big step forward amid injury recovery
articles.summary: The Detroit Tigers placed Riley Greene on the 10-day IL with a right hamstring strain in early-mid August. With the club set to take on the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday, the organization received an inspiring injury update regarding Greene’s recovery. Reports indicate that the 25-year-ol
articles._body: The Detroit Tigers placed Riley Greene on the 10-day IL with a right hamstring strain in early-mid August. With the club set to take on the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday, the organization received an inspiring injury update regarding Greene’s recovery. Reports indicate that the 25-year-old left fielder will begin his rehab assignment at Triple-A Toledo, according to Jason Beck of MLB.com. He will serve as a designated hitter on Saturday before eventually transitioning to the outfield. “Riley Greene begins a rehab assignment for Triple-A Toledo,” Beck reported. “He’ll DH tonight, then hopefully play LF tomorrow. Mud Hens are in St. Paul this weekend. Tigers begin series at Minnesota on Monday.” The return of the fifth-year pro will be a nice upgrade in the outfield for Detroit. Although the Tigers have struggled throughout this season and playoff hopes are dwindling, Greene can at least provide an uptick in offensive production for the final stretch of the regular season. In 422 at-bats so far this season, Greene has totaled 115 hits, 16 home runs, and 54 RBIs, giving him a .273 batting average and .366 OBP. He’s also a consistent defender, as Riley Greene owns a .995 fielding percentage and has recorded just one error this year. His efforts in the 2026 campaign earned him the third All-Star nod of his career. While Greene continues progressing toward a return to the lineup, the Tigers will rely on Javier Baez in left field, Max Clark in center, and Ben Malgeri at right. Those three will take up the bottom of the order for Saturday’s contest against the Dodgers. articles.title: Aces sign Kalani Brown following NaLyssa Smith’s season-ending injury
articles.summary: The Las Vegas Aces announced the signing of veteran center Kalani Brown. The decision came following NaLyssa Smith’s season-ending injury, which occurred during the Aces 88-78 win against the Toronto Tempo. WNBA insider Khristina Williams recently announced the signing in her latest tweet. “Break
articles._body: The Las Vegas Aces announced the signing of veteran center Kalani Brown. The decision came following NaLyssa Smith’s season-ending injury , which occurred during the Aces 88-78 win against the Toronto Tempo. WNBA insider Khristina Williams recently announced the signing in her latest tweet . “Breaking: Kalani Brown is signing with the Las Vegas Aces, sources told @GrlsTlkSportsTV Brown became an UFA in April after a buyout with the Phoenix Mercury. The move comes after NaLyssa Smith was ruled out for the season,” she wrote. The Aces don’t need much, but if they get the Kalani Brown that’s been shooting like she did in Phoenix and China, then we might have a problem on our hands In 2023, Brown was just the second player in WNBA history to shoot 60% from the field and 80% at the line pic.twitter.com/w2dOaozjtJ — christan (no i), ß (@ChristanWNBA) August 29, 2026 Back in April this year, the Mercury agreed to a buyout with the WNBA center and Brown became an unrestricted free agent afterward. For those unaware, Brown comes from a basketball heritage. Her father, P.J. Brown, is a former NBA champion who played for the Boston Celtics. Additionally, he played for Louisiana Tech University along with Kalani’s mother, DeJuna. With Smith now out for the season, the road to the playoffs looks challenging for the defending WNBA champion team . However, the Aces will have a much-needed option on the frontcourt as Brown prepares to join the roster. Smith was a key player for the Aces while starting all 38 games she played this season. Before falling to the injury, she was averaging 11.7 points with 6.4 rebounds per game. Her shooting from the field remained an impressive 63.8%, per Basketball Reference. Now with a much-needed victory over the Tempo, the Aces have an improved record of 27-13 overall. Las Vegas plays the Seattle Storm next on Thursday, September 17, at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle. articles.title: When will Dodgers decide if Shohei Ohtani will pitch vs. Tigers?
articles.summary: With fans wondering when Los Angeles Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani will return to pitching, it appears that manager Dave Roberts could be in the same boat. As Ohtani’s next start for the Dodgers is still up in the air, with some speculating on Sunday against the Detroit Tigers, Roberts would s
articles._body: With fans wondering when Los Angeles Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani will return to pitching , it appears that manager Dave Roberts could be in the same boat. As Ohtani’s next start for the Dodgers is still up in the air , with some speculating on Sunday against the Detroit Tigers, Roberts would speak on the topic after Friday’s 2-1 win. According to David Vassegh at SportsNet LA, Roberts would express on Saturday that Ohtani’s knee and “overall body” aren’t fully healthy and that a start for Sunday is “uncertain.” The skipper for Los Angeles would also say that he will let Detroit know of Sunday’s starter after Saturday afternoon’s outing. “Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani’s left knee and overall body is not 100% and tomorrow’s potential 1-inning start is still uncertain,” Vassegh wrote on X, formerly Twitter. “Roberts said he will let Tigers know after the game who will be #Dodgers SP for tomorrow’s game,” Vassegh continued. This would fall in line with Roberts’ comments on Friday, as there was no word about Ohtani’s start for Sunday. “Still TBD if Shohei Ohtani will start Sunday for Dodgers, per Dave Roberts,” Jack Harris of The California Post wrote. “Ohtani threw a 20-pitch bullpen session before today’s game. They’ll see how he comes in tomorrow before deciding.” More about Dodgers’ Shohei Ohtani If there’s one thing for certain, the Dodgers want to be extra careful with Ohtani, as while he’s been healthy enough to hit and do it well, a trip to the mound could cause more injury if he isn’t 100 percent healthy. This is Roberts’ concern, saying it’s the “hard part” in figuring out when to pitch him. “Roberts said it’s the ‘total body’ that isn’t 100%, including the bicep that bothered Ohtani earlier in the year,” Katie Woo of The Athletic wrote. “That’s the hard part right now is trying to figure out if he’s not 100% in the overall body, is it worth giving him an inning to build up?” Roberts said. It remains to be seen if Ohtani pitches on Sunday, as the last time he was on the mound was on July 3. articles._body: First-year Richland (N.J.) St. Augustine Prep head football coach Bill Belton is a passionate guy. So much so that after his first victory as the Hermits’ lead man, the New Jersey high school football head coach suffered a serious injury while celebrating the win, according to a report by NJ.com . [ $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] Per the report by the outlet, Belton had jumped up in jubilation and when he landed, tore his left Achilles. The St. Augustine Prep head coach just led the Hermits to a thrilling 24-20 victory over No. 31 ranked Monsignor Bonner of Pennsylvania. Belton said to NJ.com that he knew the moment he landed that something was wrong. “I was happy for the kid, jumped up in the air, felt the pop and said ‘Ah, definitely tore my Achilles,’” said Belton. “Once I heard, I knew this isn’t good. “Tonight was one of the craziest nights of my life by far, between the punts, the (Achilles), never had a night like this before. It was crazy. Just happy for the kids.” Belton was tabbed during the off-season as the Hermits’ lead man of the football program back in mid-April after leading Winslow Township to back-to-back New Jersey State Interscholastic Athletic Association ( NJSIAA ) Public Group 4 state championships. Belton enters Year 1 taking over for Pete Lancetta , who last month the school parted ways with. Belton has found plenty of success coaching at his alma mater Winslow Township the last four years as he compiled a impressive 42-9 mark, winning three straight sectional titles along with the consecutive NJSIAA state championships in the process. While the Hermits’ head coach will be trying to recover from the injury, there’s no rest for the weary as St. Augustine Prep is back at it next week when they take on Atlantic City (N.J.) on the road on Sep. 5. articles.title: BREAKING: Sun Devils name their starting QB
articles.summary: There are some starting position battles and two-deep decisions to be made between now and the Sun Devils’ September 5th opener, but the one position battle that has naturally been under the microscope ever since spring has now been decided. Following today’s practice, Arizona State head coach
articles._body: <a href="https://www.on3.com/sites/asu-devils/join/?utm_source=publisher&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=subscriber_referral&ref=1035347"> <img src="https://on3static.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=95,format=jpg/uploads/dev/assets/cms/2026/08/28182555/Devils-Digest-KS.png"> </a> <a href="https://www.SanTanFord.com"> <img src="https://on3static.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=95,format=jpg/uploads/dev/assets/cms/2025/07/25180034/2024-San-Tan-Ford-Banner-3.jpg"> </a> There are some starting position battles and two-deep decisions to be made between now and the Sun Devils’ September 5 th opener, but the one position battle that has naturally been under the microscope ever since spring has now been decided. Following today’s practice, Arizona State head coach Kenny Dillingham announced that Kentucky transfer and third-year player Cutter Boley. The 6-foot-5, 220-pound Boley played in 11 of 12 games for the Wildcats in the 2025 season and started in 10 of those contests. During that campaign, he passed for 2,160 yards and 15 touchdowns with 12 interceptions, posting a completion rate of 65.8%. He also scored two rushing touchdowns. Boley set the school freshman record for both touchdown passes and completion rate, and after playing in eight SEC games last year, he ranked 3rd in pass completion percentage in that conference. Dillingham’s familiarity with Boley led Arizona State to target the quarterback on the first day of the transfer portal, which, just days later, on January 3 rd, led to Boley committing to the Sun Devils. “So I recruited him to Oregon when I was there. And I just remember he was a really good athlete. People don’t give him enough credit for his athleticism,” Dillingham said in a previous interview. “He’s a very good athlete. Was a good basketball player. And then he had all the arm strength and all the ability of what he could do. “I remembered who he was, and I remembered a lot about him from his visit out there to Oregon. It was someone that I knew I wanted to target from the beginning. What excites me about him is his completion percentage was fairly high for what they (Kentucky) were asking him to do. I saw him operate within their system really well, get the ball to where they were supposed to go, extend with his legs when he needed to.” When Boley reflected on his development after transferring from Kentucky, he noted that this past spring was the first time he had a high-level quarterback coach in ASU offensive coordinator Marcus Arroyo. In a previous interview, Boley said that over the summer, he focused on certain aspects to help me prepare for fall camp and the upcoming season. “Getting overall stronger is something I was working on a lot in the offseason,” Boley described, “my footwork and getting my feet faster. I put a lot of muscle on my legs and my body in general as a whole. I really took care of my arm…so those are some big things I did as an offseason.” The acclimatization process for Boley has gotten easier and easier, as he noted that his comfort and the ability to operate the offense have increased by leaps and bounds since arriving here, which is important on a team with nearly four dozen newcomers. “We have a lot of new guys with 40-something,” Boley remarked. “As a whole entire group, everyone’s came along, and this is starting to feel just like another thing. You show up, and you know exactly what you’re doing. We spent countless hours in here as a team just doing extra stuff together because we wanted to, because we know where we want to be, and we know where we want to get to, and what our goals are. “That was something super special. We knew it would pay off now, and we’re starting to see it pay off early on in (fall) camp.” Devils Digest will continue to update this developing story throughout the day. articles._body: Phoenix Mercury guard Kahleah Copper is expected to play against the Toronto Tempo on Saturday despite dealing with a left ankle injury. As the Mercury (13-26) look to snap their four-game losing streak against the Tempo (11-28) at 7 p.m. PT, the team listed Copper as probable on its latest injury report Saturday morning. Phoenix also listed Marta Suarez as questionable as she remains in concussion protocol, while Kelsey Plum has been ruled out with a left lower leg injury . Copper last appeared in the Mercury’s 80-73 loss to the Washington Mystics on Thursday. The 32-year-old guard finished with 35 points, four rebounds, two steals and one assist across 32 minutes. She shot 13-for-22 from the field, including 2-for-4 from 3-point range, and went 7-for-9 from the free-throw line. Watch WNBA games LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Now in her third season with Phoenix, Copper is averaging a career-high 21.3 points along with 3.6 rebounds and 1.9 assists across 38 games. She is shooting 44.5% from the field and 29.8% from beyond the arc while averaging 32.9 minutes per game. Copper’s probable designation puts her on track to remain in the lineup as Phoenix attempts to end its recent slide and close its six-game homestand with a victory. Following Saturday’s matchup, the Mercury will embark on a brief two-game road trip. Phoenix will open the trip against the Portland Fire (16-23) on Thursday at 7 p.m. PT. articles.title: Booger McFarland names Top 5 defensive players in college football for 2026 season
articles.summary: ESPN’s Booger McFarland named his top five defensive players in college football going into the 2026 season Saturday. They come from all positions, as he revealed on College Football Countdown. Generally, the flashiest defensive players are the ones in the pass rushing positions, mostly EDGE defende
articles._body: ESPN’s Booger McFarland named his top five defensive players in college football going into the 2026 season Saturday. They come from all positions, as he revealed on College Football Countdown . Generally, the flashiest defensive players are the ones in the pass rushing positions, mostly EDGE defenders. Because of their sack totals, tackles for loss, etc., those defensive players get shine. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage But what about guys in the secondary or other big uglies up front? They’re just as important and can change the course of a football game. So let’s dive into McFarland’s selections. Dylan Stewart , EDGE – South Carolina Stewart really stood out as a freshman defensive player back in 2024 and he followed it up with a productive sophomore campaign. Now a junior, Stewart could emerge as the best pass rusher in college football. Last year, Stewart logged 33 tackles, 12 tackles for loss, 4.5 sacks, two pass deflections and three forced fumbles. In total (24 games), he has 56 tackles, 22.5 tackles for loss, 11 sacks, three pass deflections, two fumble recoveries and six forced fumbles. Colin Simmons , EDGE – Texas If there’s one defensive player that can help carry Texas to a national championship this year it’s Simmons. He’s another third year guy, like Stewart, that broke out right away as a freshman.  Simmons really came into his own last year, leading the SEC in sacks with 12. All told, he’s played 29 games and logged 91 tackles, 29.5 tackles for loss, 21 sacks, one interception, four pass deflections, one fumble recovery and six forced fumbles. Leonard Moore , CB – Notre Dame Potentially the best cornerback in the country, certainly when it comes to the NFL Draft projections, Moore also makes McFarland’s list of best defensive players in the country. A shutdown defensive back on his side of the field, he should lead an elite defensive unit in 2026. Moore had five interceptions last year en route to All-American honors. He’s played 26 games over the last two years and has 79 tackles, two tackles for loss, seven interceptions, one pick six, 18 pass deflections and three forced fumbles. KJ Bolden , S – Georgia Bolden goes into his third season with the Bulldogs and makes McFarland’s top five defensive players going into 2026. He’s a first round talent in the 2027 NFL Draft, great in coverage and a hard hitting safety. Last year, Bolden had 76 tackles, 2.5 tackles for loss, two interceptions, five pass deflections and one fumble recovery. Bolden has 135 career tackles, three picks and 4.5 tackles for loss in his career. A’Mauri Washington , DT – Oregon To wrap up McFarland’s top five defensive players, Washington makes the list! The big Oregon defensive lineman took some time to develop after his freshman season in 2023. But he carved out a role as a sophomore and broke out last year. Last year, Washington had 33 tackles, 4.5 tackles for loss, 1.5 sacks and eight pass deflections! That’s right, eight! Good luck trying to throw the ball over the offensive line when Washington is lurking on the other side.
